boundary: Source declarations, including Preview/Edit pairs. Not a live registration or release-acceptance result.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPAssetDelete
tools.summary: Permanently delete one saved asset after fresh checks and preview confirmation; no undo or automatic retry
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved asset after fresh checks and preview confirmation; no undo or automatic retry. Refuses referenced, dirty, open, read-only or unsafe source-control targets, maps, redirectors and multi-asset packages. Never force-deletes or removes imported source files.

parameters.name: AssetPath
parameters.description: Exact saved /Game asset object path, for example /Game/Tests/Unused.Unused. No short names, folders or package-only paths.

parameters.name: Confirmation
parameters.description: Copy the separate preview token within 60 seconds. Target identity and file contents must remain unchanged. The token is consumed before deletion.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPAssetRevert
tools.summary: Reload a saved Blueprint or data-asset package, discarding ALL unsaved changes approved by preview; never saves
tools.description: Reload a saved Blueprint or data-asset package, discarding ALL unsaved changes approved by preview; never saves. Memory or disk changes after preview invalidate confirmation. Refuses open asset editors and detected live-world references. May reinstance references and reset global undo history. Re-read asset IDs, values and references after reload. A failed verification reports unknown change state; inspect it before further edits.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required saved Blueprint or data-asset path, or unique short name. Prefer an exact path such as /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty, ambiguous, unsupported or unsaved assets are refused.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Required exact DISCARD confirmation string from the latest PreviewTurboMCPAssetRevert for this asset. Expires after 60 seconds and is consumed before reload. Empty, expired, replaced or stale tokens are refused; preview again. Do not construct a token yourself.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPAssetUndo
tools.summary: Undo the latest global TurboMCP transaction for the named Blueprint; does not explicitly compile or save
tools.description: Undo the latest global TurboMCP transaction for the named Blueprint; does not explicitly compile or save. Never skips unrelated entries. Editor Redo remains available after successful undo.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous values are refused; prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Required exact transaction GUID returned by PreviewTurboMCPAssetUndo for this asset. Empty or stale confirmation is refused; preview again if the undo stack changes.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPBatchEdit
tools.summary: Apply ordered repoints in one undo transaction, including requested source deletion; loads the Blueprint and does not compile or save
tools.description: Apply ordered repoints in one undo transaction, including requested source deletion; loads the Blueprint and does not compile or save. All operations must target one asset and graph. Later plans see preceding simulated changes. Preview does not guarantee apply. Failed edits attempt owned undo and compare restored source state and the dirty flag; undo does not certify compilation. If restoration cannot be verified, further TurboMCP edit calls are blocked for the editor session. Inspect and recover the asset before restarting; do not save unverified changes.

parameters.name: Operations
parameters.description: Required nonempty JSON array of operation objects, or an object containing only a lowercase operations array. Each entry requires string asset, graphName (or graph, not both), sourceNodeId, sourcePin, targetNodeId and targetPin. Both pins are outputs. targetNodeId may be empty with targetTypeId for creation. Optional id defaults to operation-N and must be unique; kind defaults to exact graphRepoint, the only supported kind. Optional keepSource accepts boolean or true/false/1/0 text; empty or omitted retains the source. Other fields are strings. Operation field names are case-insensitive; unknown or case-duplicate fields refuse. Empty input/array and malformed JSON refuse. Example with actual reader IDs substituted: [{"asset":"/Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest","graphName":"EventGraph","sourceNodeId":"source reader ID","sourcePin":"ReturnValue","targetNodeId":"target reader ID","targetPin":"ReturnValue","keepSource":true}]. Both nodes must expose the named outputs.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPBindFunction
tools.summary: Connect an existing function through a Create Event node in one undo transaction; replaces the target input and marks the asset modified, with no compile or save
tools.description: Connect an existing function through a Create Event node in one undo transaction; replaces the target input and marks the asset modified, with no compile or save. Requires an idle editor. Preview exercises graph/schema callbacks on a copy; successful preview does not guarantee a later edit. Inspect the result and arrange new nodes before compiling and saving. Repeating the identical compatible function/object binding is unchanged. Replaced source nodes are retained and listed for inspection. This creates a delegate value; the owning Bind or Timer node must execute for registration. Read back, tidy the affected nodes, inspect a capture, then compile and save explicitly.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous values are refused; prefer a full path.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required unique K2 graph name from the reader, e.g. EventGraph. Empty, missing and ambiguous names are refused.

parameters.name: TargetNodeId
parameters.description: Exact reader ID or unique hexadecimal node key of at least six digits in GraphName. Missing or ambiguous IDs are refused. Qualified IDs must match the named graph.

parameters.name: TargetPin
parameters.description: Required exact delegate input pin name, case-sensitive and not trimmed. Existing input links are replaced. Empty, orphaned, ambiguous or non-delegate pins are refused; use the reader's pin name.

parameters.name: FunctionName
parameters.description: Required existing function name on self or the chosen object class, e.g. HandleClicked. Uses Unreal name matching; whitespace is not trimmed for lookup. Empty, missing or delegate-incompatible functions are refused. Does not create the function.

parameters.name: ObjectNodeId
parameters.description: Exact reader ID or unique hexadecimal node key of at least six digits in GraphName. Missing or ambiguous IDs are refused. Qualified IDs must match the named graph. Supply with ObjectPin; both empty selects self.

parameters.name: ObjectPin
parameters.description: Exact object-reference output pin name, case-sensitive and not trimmed. Supply together with ObjectNodeId; both empty selects self. Example: ReturnValue when the named node actually exposes that object output.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPBindNewEvent
tools.summary: Create a typed custom event wired to an existing delegate input in one undo transaction
tools.description: Create a typed custom event wired to an existing delegate input in one undo transaction. Replaces that input connection; no compile or save. This does not create the Bind Event node or execute registration. Requires an idle editor. Preview exercises graph/schema callbacks on a copy; successful preview does not guarantee a later edit. Inspect the result and arrange new nodes before compiling and saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous values are refused; prefer a full path.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required unique graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty or unresolved names are refused.

parameters.name: TargetNodeId
parameters.description: Exact reader ID or unique hexadecimal node key of at least six digits in GraphName. Missing or ambiguous IDs are refused. Qualified IDs must match the named graph.

parameters.name: TargetPin
parameters.description: Required exact delegate input pin name, case-sensitive and not trimmed. Existing input links are replaced. Empty, orphaned, ambiguous or non-delegate pins are refused; use the reader's pin name.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: Required unused identifier containing letters, digits or underscores, not starting with a digit; no whitespace. Example: OnSelectionChanged. Existing function/event names are refused. Event graphs only; parameters come from the target delegate. Return/output-value signatures are refused. The new event has no execution body. Connect its body separately and ensure the target Bind node executes at runtime. Replaced source nodes are retained; inspect remaining uses before cleanup.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPBlueprintReparent
tools.summary: Edit Blueprint reparenting; execution refreshes nodes and compiles but never saves, and undo is not guaranteed across reinstancing
tools.description: Edit Blueprint reparenting; execution refreshes nodes and compiles but never saves, and undo is not guaranteed across reinstancing.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Exact Blueprint asset path. Normal actor/object/widget Blueprints only; loading may execute project callbacks.

parameters.name: NewParent
parameters.description: Exact class object path, including _C for Blueprint-generated classes. Incompatible families, cycles and declaration conflicts refuse.

parameters.name: ExpectedParent
parameters.description: Exact current parent class path returned by preview. A changed parent refuses before mutation.

parameters.name: Confirmation
parameters.description: Exact confirmation text returned by preview, authorizing this asset/parent change and compilation. Compilation may execute project code and reinstance objects. Failure after mutation is reported as changed; no rollback or save is implied.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPCallLog
tools.summary: Enable or disable call recording and request persistence in editor settings
tools.description: Enable or disable call recording and request persistence in editor settings. Existing records are retained. Calls made while recording was off are not recovered.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Required boolean text: true/on/yes/1 enables recording; false/off/no/0 disables it. Case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. Empty and other values are refused. Example: true.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPCallLogClear
tools.summary: Clear retained in-memory call records after confirmation
tools.description: Clear retained in-memory call records after confirmation. Leaves the disk log and recording setting unchanged. This request may itself leave new records when recording is enabled.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Required confirmation text: yes or true, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. Empty and other values are refused. Example: yes.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPComment
tools.summary: Create, change, resize or delete comment boxes in an undo transaction; loads/measures the graph and does not compile or save
tools.description: Create, change, resize or delete comment boxes in an undo transaction; loads/measures the graph and does not compile or save. Deleting a box keeps its nodes. Explicit fit expands outward to preserve the old rectangle; fit without Nodes fits current contents. refit requires Box and Nodes and moves/resizes only the box around that explicit selection; unselected nodes remain in place and may be left outside. Inspect preview geometry before applying.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required existing graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Use the reader's name; missing targets are refused.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Required create, set, fit, refit or delete; case-insensitive and trimmed. Empty/unknown actions refuse.

parameters.name: Nodes
parameters.description: Comma- or pipe-separated reader node IDs. Required for create; for fit selects nodes to enclose and requires Box. Empty fit uses current box contents. Unused for set/delete; pass empty.

parameters.name: Box
parameters.description: Existing comment ID for set/delete. For fit, empty with empty Nodes selects all boxes; nonempty selects one box. Explicit fit with Nodes requires one Box. refit always requires one Box and explicit Nodes. Unused for create; pass empty.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Comment label for create/set; empty means no supplied label on create or leave unchanged on set, not clear. Whitespace is retained. Unused for fit/delete; pass empty. Example: Input handling.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: Optional #RRGGBB or comma-separated RGB values 0..255, e.g. #3A6EA5. Empty uses the new box default or preserves an existing color. Used by create/set; otherwise pass empty.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Optional width x height in graph units, e.g. 400x200. Each side must be finite numeric text in 1..2147483647; fractional parts truncate. Empty create encloses selected nodes; empty set keeps size. Explicit create size overrides automatic enclosure. Automatic height includes wrapped-title clearance; new boxes have no floating comment bubble. Used by create/set; otherwise pass empty.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPCommonButtonStyle
tools.summary: Inspect or change explicit shared CommonButtonStyle Blueprint defaults
tools.description: Inspect or change explicit shared CommonButtonStyle Blueprint defaults.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required compiled CommonButtonStyle Blueprint path, not a widget. All buttons using this shared asset may change. No compile/save/runtime refresh is performed; recreate affected widgets after compiling to verify visuals.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact reflected path. Empty lists readable fields for read only. Examples: ButtonPadding or NormalHovered.TintColor.SpecifiedColor. Paths descend structs, never objects/containers. Edit conditions and color-use rules still apply. Native references and localized text are read-only.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Required Unreal property text, not JSON; up to 65536 characters. Example padding: (Left=8,Top=4,Right=8,Bottom=4). Example color: (R=0.2,G=0.5,B=0.8,A=1). Partial structs retain other fields. Preview first; edit reparses current state. Invalid/non-finite values refuse. Requires an idle editor outside PIE.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPCompile
tools.summary: Compile up to 25 named assets and report compiler and engine diagnostics; does not save
tools.description: Compile up to 25 named assets and report compiler and engine diagnostics; does not save. Compilation can reinstance classes and affect dependent objects. Public tool calls refuse during play or an active editor transaction. Earlier edits from other tools are not undone or queued: stop play, inspect ReadTurboMCPDirtyList, then compile and explicitly save wanted changes. Inspect each asset result before saving; this is not an atomic batch.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest|/Game/Tests/WBP_NodeTest. Empty lists and lists over 25 entries are refused. Unsupported asset types are reported individually.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPCustomEventAdd
tools.summary: Create a standalone typed custom event in an existing event graph
tools.description: Create a standalone typed custom event in an existing event graph. Local, non-replicated; not an override or delegate binding. No compile or save. Duplicate names refuse. Loading assets can run engine load hooks.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint object path or unique asset name.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact existing event graph name. Function and macro graphs refuse.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: New event identifier, at most 128 characters; must not collide with existing or inherited callables.

parameters.name: Inputs
parameters.description: Empty for no inputs, otherwise comma-separated Name:type pairs, for example Amount:float, Label:string. Container type commas stay inside angle brackets. At most 32 unique data parameters; no execution, delegate or wildcard types. Event parameters become output pins for subsequent append links.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDataAssetCreate
tools.summary: Create a fresh typed Data Asset, preserving class defaults
tools.description: Create a fresh typed Data Asset, preserving class defaults. Preview validates without allocation. Edit creates in memory; saving and source-control add are explicit. Constructors may execute project code. Never overwrites an existing package or compiles Blueprints.

parameters.name: ClassPath
parameters.description: Exact already loaded concrete UDataAsset class path; Blueprint-generated paths end in _C. Unloaded, abstract, transient and superseded classes are refused.

parameters.name: PackagePath
parameters.description: New /Game package path without object suffix or extension, for example /Game/Data/DA_Menu.

parameters.name: InitialFieldsJSON
parameters.description: JSON object of editable field names to Unreal property-text strings. Empty means class defaults. Scalar/value-struct values and loaded external references are supported; containers and owned children use subsequent property edits.

parameters.name: Save
parameters.description: Explicit disk save after creation. Default false. A saved file is not removed by Undo.

parameters.name: AddToSourceControl
parameters.description: Add the saved file through the current provider; requires Save=true. Default false. Failure preserves the asset and reports partial completion. Never checks out or submits.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDataAssetProperty
tools.summary: Edit one data-asset property using temporary validation
tools.description: Edit one data-asset property using temporary validation. Requires the current reader revision. No implicit save or compile. Edit notifications may run project code. The tool verifies resulting state and attempts restoration on mismatch; inspect the final result and rollback status.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Exact asset path or uniquely resolved asset name; must resolve to UDataAsset.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact reflected property path from ReadTurboMCPDataAssetProperty. External objects are never implicit edit targets.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: set, array_remove, array_insert, map_upsert, map_remove, create_child or child_set. array_remove removes one existing array element and preserves all remaining values and their order; array_insert inserts before Key (0..count; count appends), preserving existing order. Whole-array set is unsupported. child_set edits an existing owned map child selected by Key. create_child creates a compatible instanced object in an empty property/map entry; it never replaces an existing child. Set changes one scalar/value-struct or existing object reference; map operations change one entry, preserving unrelated entries.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: For array_remove/array_insert, an exact zero-based decimal index (e.g. 64 removes the 65th element). Otherwise, exact loaded object path for object keys or Unreal property text. Required for map operations and map-child creation; empty for set or direct child creation.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Unreal property text for value fields, or exact loaded object path for references. Empty for map_remove/array_remove. For array_insert, empty inserts a default element; explicit values support scalar/value structs or loaded compatible hard references, not reference-containing struct text. Use quoted empty string for a string element. Example integer: 42. Object example: /Game/Input/IA_Jump.IA_Jump. For child_set, use JSON: {"property":"Number","value":"42"}. For create_child, use JSON: {"class":"/Script/EnhancedInput.PlayerMappableKeySettings","fields":{"Name":"Jump"}}. Initial fields are scalar/value-struct property-text strings. Other operations do not accept stock engine JSON.

parameters.name: Revision
parameters.description: Exact revision returned by the reader or preview; stale revisions refuse without writing. Read again after any change.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDataTableRows
tools.summary: Set or remove DataTable rows in an undo transaction; removals discard row data and edits may run editor callbacks and mark the package dirty; does not explicitly compile or save
tools.description: Set or remove DataTable rows in an undo transaction; removals discard row data and edits may run editor callbacks and mark the package dirty; does not explicitly compile or save. Validates the operation list before writing. Failed read-back attempts to undo this transaction; the result distinguishes verified row restoration from unverified or failed rollback. External callback effects are not covered by row restoration checks.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required DataTable name or package/object path, for example /Game/Data/DT_Items; empty, ambiguous, unresolved or non-DataTable targets are refused. Prefer a full path.

parameters.name: Rows
parameters.description: Required array of operation strings, for example ["Potion = Health=100,Label=\"Small potion\"", "- Obsolete"]. Each string sets named fields or removes a named row. A set creates a missing row; unspecified fields keep existing values, or the row struct's defaults for a new row. Use internal field names when display labels are ambiguous and Unreal export-text syntax for values, including quoted text and parenthesized structs/containers. Empty arrays or all-blank lines are refused; blank lines within a nonempty request are skipped. Empty field values are passed to the type importer, not treated as omitted. Empty/None row names, duplicate fields in one operation and conflicting/repeated removals are refused. No implicit operation is supplied.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDelegateRetarget
tools.summary: Edit the function selected by an existing Create Event node in place; preserves its identity, object input and consumers, with no compile or save
tools.description: Edit the function selected by an existing Create Event node in place; preserves its identity, object input and consumers, with no compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint path or unique asset name. Loading may execute project callbacks. Requires an idle editor outside PIE or compilation.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact unique K2 graph name from the reader.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Exact full or short reader ID for a Create Event node in GraphName. Missing, ambiguous or unconnected delegate signatures refuse.

parameters.name: FunctionName
parameters.description: Existing compatible function on the node's actual object scope. Same function is a clean no-op. Does not change the object or register a runtime delegate; the consuming Bind or Timer node must execute. Unlike BindFunction, this keeps the existing node and all consumers.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDiagnosticConsole
tools.summary: Run a diagnostic query or a separately confirmed process-wide change; dispatch alone does not verify later effects
tools.description: Run a diagnostic query or a separately confirmed process-wide change; dispatch alone does not verify later effects. Log, Slate debugger and CVar effects are process-wide, even with a PIE target. No shell, file operations or arbitrary console commands. Dispatch is not proof of asynchronous effects; use ReadTurboMCPEditorLog.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Exact editor or pie:<instance number>. Missing or ambiguous worlds refuse.

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: One command: Log list [category], Log <exact category> <verbosity>, SlateDebugger.Event.Start/Stop, or an existing CVar name with an optional single value. No chaining or newlines. Preview reads current state without changing it.

parameters.name: Confirmation
parameters.description: Empty for queries. For changes, copy the token from the latest separate preview within 60 seconds; each preview replaces the previous token. A changed target, command or current CVar/log value requires a fresh preview. Session changes are not saved; restore the previous value when finished.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPDispatcherAdd
tools.summary: Declare an event dispatcher with named, typed input parameters
tools.description: Declare an event dispatcher with named, typed input parameters. Any existing member with this name refuses, including an identical dispatcher. This creates the signature only; it does not bind listeners, create call nodes or invoke the dispatcher. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: Name=OnPurchase; Inputs=Accepted:bool,Buyer:object</Script/Engine.Actor>.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required target Blueprint asset path, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target, or an unambiguous asset name. Prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required unused member identifier, for example OnPurchase. Letters, digits and underscores only; start with a letter or underscore. None is reserved.

parameters.name: Inputs
parameters.description: Required string: comma-separated Name:Type pairs. Use an empty string for no parameters. Example: Accepted:bool,Buyer:object</Script/Engine.Actor>. Parameter names must be distinct; nested container types use shared type syntax. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPEnumAdd
tools.summary: Create a new user-defined enum in memory in an idle editor outside PIE and active transactions; marks its package dirty and may run enum callbacks, with no tool-owned undo transaction, explicit Blueprint compile or save
tools.description: Create a new user-defined enum in memory in an idle editor outside PIE and active transactions; marks its package dirty and may run enum callbacks, with no tool-owned undo transaction, explicit Blueprint compile or save. Existing assets are not overwritten. Preview does not guarantee creation or that the engine will accept every display name; edit reads names, numeric values and requested display names back. Failed creation may leave an unsaved asset for inspection.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Required new package path including the asset name, for example /Game/Enums/E_Colour; do not supply an object suffix or filesystem extension. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; empty and relative paths are refused. Use a writable content mount.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated entries in Name or Name=Display Name format, for example Red,Green=Dark Green,Blue. Names start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits or underscores; duplicates ignoring case and _MAX are refused. Values receive consecutive integers starting at zero. Empty input is refused; empty separators are skipped. Empty display text uses the engine-generated display name. Commas and pipes cannot be escaped inside display text.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPFunctionAdd
tools.summary: Create a function graph and optional signature; loads types, regenerates the skeleton and refreshes matching self-call nodes, may run editor callbacks, and does not perform a full compile or save or provide a dedicated undo transaction
tools.description: Create a function graph and optional signature; loads types, regenerates the skeleton and refreshes matching self-call nodes, may run editor callbacks, and does not perform a full compile or save or provide a dedicated undo transaction. Requires an idle editor outside PIE. Reports lost caller links as partial changes; does not automatically roll them back.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty or unresolved values are refused.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required new identifier, for example ComputeScore; starts with a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores. Empty, None, existing and parent function names are refused; whitespace is trimmed.

parameters.name: Inputs
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated Name: Type declarations, for example Score: int, Enabled: bool. Empty/default creates no inputs. Names must be unique across inputs/outputs. Types: bool, byte, int, int64, float, real, double, name, string, text; vector, rotator, transform, vector2d, linearcolor, color; loadable class/struct/enum paths; array<T>, set<T>, map<K,V>; object/class/softobject/softclass/interface<ClassPath>. No nested containers; set elements/map keys must be hashable.

parameters.name: Outputs
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated Name: Type declarations, for example Result: float. Empty/default creates no outputs. Uses the same type syntax and name rules as Inputs; no parameter default-value syntax is supported here.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPFunctionFlags
tools.summary: Inspect or change owned function purity and receiver constness
tools.description: Inspect or change owned function purity and receiver constness. Preview first; edit repeats preflight. Requires an idle editor and compiled owner. Inspects direct referencers of the owner and derived classes, with a 4096-package limit. Refuses unsafe connected callers, overrides and delegate references. Candidate assets are loaded and callbacks may run. No automatic save; compile affected assets before saving. A failed postcondition explicitly reports partial changes.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique asset name.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Required exact owned function name. Use FunctionAdd first to create a new helper.

parameters.name: Pure
parameters.description: Required keep, true or false. Removing connected execution pins or introducing an unexecuted data producer refuses.

parameters.name: Const
parameters.description: Required keep, true or false. Const constrains this receiver, not all external objects. Unsupported macro-body analysis refuses.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPFunctionLibraryCreate
tools.summary: Create a new Blueprint function library at an unused destination; no disk save or overwrite
tools.description: Create a new Blueprint function library at an unused destination; no disk save or overwrite. Never copies another asset. Preview creates nothing; edit uses the stock factory, which initializes the Blueprint class. No disk save or reliable creation-undo guarantee. Refuses PIE and active transactions.

parameters.name: PackagePath
parameters.description: Exact new /Game package path, for example /Game/Utilities/BFL_Purchase. Do not pass an object suffix, filename, short name or existing package. Created assets remain unsaved; save separately after inspection.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPFunctionRemove
tools.summary: Delete a function graph and all its nodes without repairing callers or bindings; no full compile, save or dedicated undo transaction, and editor callbacks may close asset editors and regenerate the skeleton
tools.description: Delete a function graph and all its nodes without repairing callers or bindings; no full compile, save or dedicated undo transaction, and editor callbacks may close asset editors and regenerate the skeleton. Requires an idle editor outside PIE. Does not repair callers or bindings. Removing the graph does not guarantee its name is immediately reusable; inspect the result before recreating it.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty or unresolved values are refused.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required function graph name, for example ComputeScore; case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace trimmed. Empty or ambiguous names are refused; no default. A missing name returns unchanged and lists available functions.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPFunctionRename
tools.summary: Rename an owned Blueprint function and discovered callers
tools.description: Rename an owned Blueprint function and discovered callers. Preview loads candidates; edit repeats discovery using the same arguments. Requires a compiled owner and idle editor. Direct dependent maps and more than 4096 candidate packages refuse. No save or guaranteed rollback. Compile affected assets before saving; dynamic/native references are not verified. Requires an idle editor outside play/transactions and a successfully compiled defining Blueprint. Direct dependent maps refuse; discovery refuses above 4096 candidate packages. Preview does not reserve a plan: edit discovers references again. Example: Asset=/Game/UI/WBP_Menu, Function=RefreshState, NewName=RefreshLegacyState. Preview first, inspect affected assets, then edit with the same arguments. Preview lists affected assets and call/delegate nodes. Dependencies are loaded; load callbacks may run. Edit repeats discovery, renames child overrides through stock editor APIs and updates references. No save or guaranteed rollback; compile affected assets before saving. Inherited/interface functions and name conflicts refuse. Dynamic strings, native code and unavailable content are not verified.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required defining Blueprint path or unique name. Example: /Game/UI/WBP_Menu with Function=RefreshState and NewName=RefreshLegacyState. Preview first and inspect affected assets. Requires a compiled owner and idle editor. Discovery inspects direct referencers of the owner and derived classes; dependent maps and more than 4096 direct candidate packages refuse.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Required exact owned function name; inherited overrides are not independently renamed.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Required valid new member name, 1 to 100 characters. Same name is a no-op. Edit repeats discovery with the same arguments. No save or guaranteed rollback; compile affected assets before saving. Dynamic/native references are not verified.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPGraphAppend
tools.summary: Add nodes and connections without deleting existing nodes; Placement=local searches nearby; Placement=outside uses space beyond existing bounds and may create long wires
tools.description: Add nodes and connections without deleting existing nodes; Placement=local searches nearby; Placement=outside uses space beyond existing bounds and may create long wires. Placement=per-anchor places each disconnected component near its own fixed connection, preserving existing nodes; missing or conflicting anchors and blocked local space refuse. Explicit links to occupied inputs can replace their current connections. Does not change function signatures, compile, save or prove runtime behavior. Preview validates a temporary graph; edit replans against the current graph. A successful preview is not a reservation or a guarantee of later success. Live edits use a transaction. Failures attempt undo and report whether it completed; complete restoration is unverified, so inspect before retrying. Success verifies created nodes and requested links, and reports their IDs. Repeating new node forms creates another set of nodes; this is not idempotent. Local labels name the PRECEDING node form. Prefer `(TypeId) ; label Name` for a pinless node, or put `; label Name` on its own line after the closed form. Never put a label before its node. A multiline form may end with `Value 1) ; label Name`; one node cannot have conflicting labels. Quote creation IDs containing spaces: `("Exact Type ID")`. Use flat node forms, not nested reader values. Flat example: `(TypeId` then `InputPin 1) ; label ValueNode`, followed by a separate consumer form containing `DestinationInput (-> ValueNode:OutputPin)`. Substitute discovered type IDs and pin names. Do not write `(TypeId ; label Name)` on one line: the comment hides its closing parenthesis. Every link is written on its destination INPUT: InputPin (-> SourceId:OutputPin). Whitespace-only pin names are quoted exactly as shown by NodePins: `" " (-> Source:" ")`. Preserve the spaces inside those quotes; they are engine pin names, not missing values. To feed an existing node, copy its reader form header with its node ID, then add that input link. Do not write a reverse link on a source output pin. Discover creation IDs with PreviewTurboMCPNodeType; use PreviewTurboMCPNodePins for exact pin names. Native engine search IDs are not interchangeable. In a function graph, use Function|Result for another Return; link execute from a reachable branch and set or link its result inputs. Reader branch headings (:then/:else) are read-only and are refused. They do not create wires. Instead, label the Branch Choice and write `execute (-> Choice:then)` inside the destination node form (or Choice:else for the false output). Use the exact pin names from discovery. Reference it as `(-> Name:ExactPinName)`. A pinless form needs no dummy pin. Semicolon comments consume the rest of their line: put the closing parenthesis BEFORE a trailing label/comment. Continuation: auto (legacy unique exit), all (all reachable new unconnected exec exits), or label:pin (one named new node output). Applies to displaced existing exec wires; explicit submitted target links take precedence. Compile/save deferred.

tools.description: The Edit twin of PreviewTurboMCPGraphPatch. It reaches the SAME plan, so everything it refuses the preview refused first, with the same words. ONLY A PIN WHOSE VALUE ACTUALLY DIFFERS IS WRITTEN, and that is the capability rather than an optimisation: setting every described pin to the value it already holds would dirty the asset and report a change that is not one, which is precisely what "applies only the differences" forbids. The node ids and the described pin values are read BEFORE the write and the ids are read again AFTER it, and the report is computed from those two sets - so a patch that quietly created or destroyed a node FAILS THE COMPARE instead of passing on the tool's own summary. That matters because the acceptance row is a claim about WHICH nodes changed: a patch that touches a third node has failed even when the graph still compiles.
