parameters.name: bCreateBoxes
parameters.description: Optional false (default) or true. Requires whole-graph blocks mode and at most 512 nodes; plans nested comments for control-flow blocks, preserving existing titles and refusing partial overlaps. Added comments share the layout undo.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPGraphTransfer
tools.summary: Copy one complete owned graph, including its nodes, connections, layout, comments and locals
tools.description: Copy one complete owned graph, including its nodes, connections, layout, comments and locals. Compile both assets and prepare referenced members/widgets first. Existing executable logic is never overwritten. Source-owned macro dependencies must already exist in the target; unresolved calls, missing self members and conflicting custom events refuse. Matching empty custom-event declarations can be replaced; connected, commented or disabled declarations are protected. This does not perform a whole-asset merge or automatically tidy the copied layout. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: SourceGraph=CalculatePurchase; TargetGraph=""; use exact source/target asset paths.

parameters.name: SourceAsset
parameters.description: Required source Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Prefer its full object path; the source is not edited.

parameters.name: SourceGraph
parameters.description: Required exact source function, interface-function, macro or event graph name. This selects the whole graph, not node IDs or an event label.

parameters.name: TargetAsset
parameters.description: Required different target Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Its parent class must equal or derive from the source parent class.

parameters.name: TargetGraph
parameters.description: Pass an empty string to keep SourceGraph, or a valid destination identifier. Existing event pages receive the whole source group below existing nodes, preserving internal links and relative positions; unmeasured nodes use a conservative 512-unit height. This does not splice execution chains or tidy. Nested source graphs refuse append. Existing macro graphs refuse. An existing function must contain only entry/result nodes, no locals, and have a compiled compatible signature. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPInterfaceAdd
tools.summary: Add a Blueprint interface contract and its required function declarations
tools.description: Add a Blueprint interface contract and its required function declarations. An already implemented or inherited interface is unchanged. Existing graph-name conflicts and animation-layer interfaces refuse. This does not copy source event bodies or function logic. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: Asset=/Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target; Interface=/Game/Interfaces/BPI_Menu.BPI_Menu.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required target Blueprint asset path, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target, or an unambiguous asset name. Prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: Required compiled Blueprint interface asset path/name, such as /Game/Interfaces/BPI_Menu.BPI_Menu, or a Blueprint-implementable native /Script/Module.Interface class path. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPInterfaceRemove
tools.summary: Remove a directly implemented interface while keeping its function bodies as ordinary functions
tools.description: Remove a directly implemented interface while keeping its function bodies as ordinary functions. Calls that require this interface may stop working. First preview, inspect affected callers, and pass the returned confirmation unchanged to the edit tool. Confirmation identifies the asset/interface; it is not a snapshot or stale-state lock. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: Preview the same Asset and Interface first; copy the complete confirmation value from its response into Confirm.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required target Blueprint asset path, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target, or an unambiguous asset name. Prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: Required exact directly implemented interface class path, asset object path, or unique name. Inherited interfaces cannot be removed.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Required exact confirmation value returned by PreviewTurboMCPInterfaceRemove for this asset/interface. Empty or different values refuse. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPLocalVariableAdd
tools.summary: Declare a typed local variable in one function; do not create getter/setter nodes
tools.description: Declare a typed local variable in one function; do not create getter/setter nodes. An existing local with the same type and default is unchanged; a conflicting declaration refuses. This declares storage only, not function behavior. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: Function=CalculatePurchase; Name=ItemCount; Type=int; Default=7.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required target Blueprint asset path, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target, or an unambiguous asset name. Prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Required owned function graph name, for example CalculatePurchase, including implemented interface functions. Matching is case-insensitive and must be unique. Event graphs and inherited functions are not accepted.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required identifier starting with a letter or underscore and containing only letters, digits or underscores. Must not conflict with parameters or members; None is reserved.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Required shared Blueprint type syntax, for example int, float, vector, or object</Script/Engine.Actor>. For structs, pass the plain object path, for example /Script/CoreUObject.Vector or /Game/Types/ST_Item.ST_Item; do not add a struct: prefix. The struct must support Blueprint variables.

parameters.name: Default
parameters.description: Pass an empty string for the Unreal type default. Otherwise provide a schema-valid scalar/struct literal, for example 7 for int. Explicit object/class/container defaults refuse; assign them in graph logic. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPLocalVariableRemove
tools.summary: Remove one unused local declaration from an exact owned function
tools.description: Remove one unused local declaration from an exact owned function. Referenced locals refuse; no graph nodes are deleted. Preview loads the asset but does not edit it. Edit requires a fresh preview token. No save or checkout; structural refresh can compile and affect undo.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint path or unique name; prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Exact owned function graph name. Event graphs and ambiguous names refuse.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive local variable name.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Copy the confirm token from a successful preview. Stale tokens refuse without edits.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPLocalVariableRename
tools.summary: Rename one local variable and its exact local getter/setter references
tools.description: Rename one local variable and its exact local getter/setter references. Same-named members and other functions are unchanged. Preview lists affected nodes; edit requires fresh confirmation. No save or checkout. Structural refresh can compile and affect undo; inspect before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint asset path or unique name; prefer a full path.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Exact owned function graph name.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact current local declaration name.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: New identifier; collisions with function parameters or locals refuse.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Copy the confirm token from the latest preview. Stale tokens refuse without edits.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPLocalVars
tools.summary: Promote reviewed scalar arithmetic or explicitly selected immutable input-array counts at entry, and selected stable stock loop indexes at LoopBody, retaining original calculations
tools.description: Promote reviewed scalar arithmetic or explicitly selected immutable input-array counts at entry, and selected stable stock loop indexes at LoopBody, retaining original calculations. Replans live state, compiles and verifies links; does not save. Requires a clean compile baseline and a single assignment continuation. Any selected excluded candidate refuses the whole edit. Unproven array-element, reference, latent or reentrant lifetimes are refused. Failure attempts owned undo but does not claim verified restoration. Pure-node classification is not proof of deterministic behavior or equivalent execution.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint asset path or unique asset name, for example /Game/Blueprints/BP_Player; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and empty is refused. Prefer a full path to avoid ambiguity.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Function graph name, matched without case sensitivity after trimming whitespace; event graphs are refused. Pass empty to select the first function graph in the Blueprint's stored order; the result names the selected graph. Prefer an explicit name.

parameters.name: Names
parameters.description: JSON object mapping exact output IDs from the local-variable preview to meaningful local names, for example {"<exact output ID>":"Subtotal"}. A nonempty map selects only its exact output IDs. Default {} preserves automatic selection of reviewed entry-stable arithmetic; input-array counts and loop values always require explicit selection. Unknown IDs, invalid names and name collisions are refused. Use the same mapping for preview and edit.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMaterialBlocks
tools.summary: Add labels, rewire inputs and delete redundant usage/reroute nodes in an undo transaction; recompiles materials and runs editor callbacks, does not save, and verifies only expression identities after attempted rollback
tools.description: Add labels, rewire inputs and delete redundant usage/reroute nodes in an undo transaction; recompiles materials and runs editor callbacks, does not save, and verifies only expression identities after attempted rollback. Uses existing comment boxes as blocks. Adds labels for values read by multiple blocks, merges repeated usages per block, and removes eligible internal reroutes. Existing node positions are preserved; new usages need free space inside their block. This is cleanup, not full graph layout. Edit rebuilds the plan from current state; request another preview if the material changed. Compile and identity checks do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances and material functions are refused. For an instance, explicitly name its parent material. Blocks are existing comment boxes; this tool does not create boxes or perform a full graph layout.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMaterialInstanceSet
tools.summary: Set texture overrides on a Material Instance Constant; loads the instance and textures and runs PostEditChange, which may update rendering resources; no tool-owned undo transaction or save is performed
tools.description: Set texture overrides on a Material Instance Constant; loads the instance and textures and runs PostEditChange, which may update rendering resources; no tool-owned undo transaction or save is performed. Only texture parameters are supported. Validates all requested overrides before writing and checks effective texture values afterward; failures after writing may leave partial changes with no automatic rollback. Sampler checks cover color versus linear sRGB compatibility, not all texture constraints or rendered correctness.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Material Instance Constant name or package/object path, for example /Game/Materials/MI_Item; empty, ambiguous or non-instance targets are refused. Prefer a full path.

parameters.name: Overrides
parameters.description: Required array of Parameter = TextureAsset entries, for example ["BaseColor = /Game/Textures/T_Item"]. Names match without case sensitivity and surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Each name must identify one declared texture parameter and may appear once per call; ambiguous layer/blend names are refused. Empty arrays, empty entries and unresolved textures are refused. Empty texture values do not clear overrides; scalar, vector and static-switch edits are not supported.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMaterialLabelPromote
tools.summary: Promote each exact material output and mask read by at least two distinct direct expressions to named reroutes
tools.description: Promote each exact material output and mask read by at least two distinct direct expressions to named reroutes. Reuse matching declarations, preserve existing positions, and place new usages without conservative-bound overlaps. Replans current state; a nonempty edit compiles and runs editor callbacks in an undo transaction. Does not save. Material functions and instances are refused. Failed-edit restoration is not guaranteed. Names use parameter/caption and output context. One exact output and mask must have at least two distinct direct readers; existing named-reroute readers are left alone. Existing positions are preserved; new nodes use conservative collision bounds, not full graph tidy or comment containment. Edit replans current state and compiles only when changing it. Compiler and identity checks do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances are refused; explicitly name the parent to edit its graph.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMaterialTidy
tools.summary: Move material expressions and write comment boxes in an undo transaction; recompiles before and after layout and runs editor callbacks, but does not save; failure cleanup is attempted, not certified restoration
tools.description: Move material expressions and write comment boxes in an undo transaction; recompiles before and after layout and runs editor callbacks, but does not save; failure cleanup is attempted, not certified restoration. Uses estimated expression sizes. Matching expression identities and compile errors do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances are refused; name their parent explicitly.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Legacy compatibility string; leave empty. Layout is always recomputed and an already matching result remains unchanged, including when Force is nonempty.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMenuActivate
tools.summary: Request activation of one named runtime button through normal Slate input
tools.description: Request activation of one named runtime button through normal Slate input. Requires one in-process PIE world, one local player, an active editor application, a constructed visible/enabled UMG or CommonUI button, and no tool-held input. Focuses the button and sends Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom for 0.1 seconds with automatic release. Does not invoke click delegates directly. This executes game/UI logic; there is no asset transaction, save or undo.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Exact session-bound token from ReadTurboMCPPlayInputState(Target=list), or pie:0 for a single PIE world/player. The button must belong to that player. Expired tokens and external-process clients refuse.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required exact runtime object path or unique object name from ReadTurboMCPPlayInputState. Not a designer name, display label, asset path or Slate ref. Prefer the complete runtime path when names repeat. Workflow: read current state, select its runtime button path, call once, allow normal frames for press/release, then read state and capture the viewport. A disabled/hidden/ambiguous button refuses. If focus moves but input fails, the error says so. Never retry blindly after an uncertain client outcome. @return Input delivery details and a pending-activation message, not a claim that the expected screen opened. Verify the resulting screen independently.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPMergeMembers
tools.summary: Prepare missing member declarations before copying graph bodies between Blueprints
tools.description: Prepare missing member declarations before copying graph bodies between Blueprints. Creates declared variables with defaults, function signatures, dispatcher signatures and custom-event declarations on a new named event graph. Exact-name exclusions skip creation without deleting existing target members. GraphTransfer can replace matching empty event declarations with their bodies; connected or commented target events refuse. Compatible existing members are retained; differing variable types or callable signatures refuse. Compile both assets first. Does not copy widget trees, interfaces, function bodies, animations or bindings. Add required interfaces and copy widget subtrees separately, then use GraphTransfer. A failed edit can leave earlier declarations created; inspect the target before retrying. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: SourceAsset=/Game/UI/WBP_Source.WBP_Source; TargetAsset=/Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target.

parameters.name: SourceAsset
parameters.description: Required source Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Prefer its full object path; the source is not edited.

parameters.name: TargetAsset
parameters.description: Required different target Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Its parent class must equal or derive from the source parent class.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional comma- or pipe-separated exact source member names to skip, case-insensitive. Empty includes all. Unknown names refuse before changes. Skipped dependencies may need separate preparation before transferring bodies. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPNodePinGrowth
tools.summary: Edit growth of variadic pins on Make Array, Sequence or associative operators; does not shrink, compile or save
tools.description: Edit growth of variadic pins on Make Array, Sequence or associative operators; does not shrink, compile or save. Workflow: append a base node, read its ID, preview/grow, then connect new pins explicitly. Existing pins and links are preserved. No shrink, compile or save. An equal target is a clean no-op.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint asset path or unique name. Loading may execute project callbacks.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name in the Blueprint.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Exact full reader ID of the existing supported node.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Desired total, decimal integer 1..32. Sequence counts output branches; array/operator counts inputs. Unsupported native limits refuse.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPOverrideAdd
tools.summary: Create an event or function override through the editor API; may regenerate the skeleton and run editor callbacks, uses engine-managed undo, and does not perform a full compile or save
tools.description: Create an event or function override through the editor API; may regenerate the skeleton and run editor callbacks, uses engine-managed undo, and does not perform a full compile or save. Existing implementations return unchanged without creating a duplicate. Preview is not a reservation; edit checks again. Creates only the override entry, not its behavior. Event results include the exact node ID and graph. Connect the body, inspect parent-call requirements and tidy affected nodes before compiling.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty is refused.

parameters.name: FunctionOrEvent
parameters.description: Required reflected name from ReadTurboMCPOverrides, for example ReceiveActorOnClicked; case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace trimmed. Empty or unavailable names are refused; no default.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPOverrideRemove
tools.summary: Delete an override event node or an entire override function graph and its contents; uses an undo transaction, may regenerate the skeleton and run editor callbacks, and does not perform a full compile or save
tools.description: Delete an override event node or an entire override function graph and its contents; uses an undo transaction, may regenerate the skeleton and run editor callbacks, and does not perform a full compile or save. Requires an idle editor with undo available. Event removal reports the exact removed node and detached connections. Other nodes remain; inspect their remaining uses before explicit GraphRemove cleanup. Function removal can close asset editors. Refuses ambiguous matches and local functions. Review the Blueprint after removal; this tool does not repair callers or prove compilation succeeds.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty or unresolved values are refused.

parameters.name: FunctionOrEvent
parameters.description: Required reflected override name from ReadTurboMCPOverrides with include=overridden, for example ReceiveActorOnClicked; case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace trimmed, no default. Empty is refused.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPPinDefault
tools.summary: Set one unconnected K2 input pin default; records an undo transaction and marks the Blueprint dirty; schema callbacks may run and object literals may load assets; does not explicitly compile or save
tools.description: Set one unconnected K2 input pin default; records an undo transaction and marks the Blueprint dirty; schema callbacks may run and object literals may load assets; does not explicitly compile or save. Validates the literal before editing and reads the pin back afterward. Successful changed/unchanged results identify the actual node, pin and normalized display value; display text is not serialized edit syntax. A failed read-back attempts to undo only this tool's transaction; restoration is not verified.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint asset path or unique asset name accepted by the asset resolver; empty is invalid. Prefer a full path such as /Game/Blueprints/BP_Player.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required graph name from the reader, such as EventGraph; matches the whole name without case sensitivity. Empty or ambiguous names are refused; whitespace is not trimmed.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Required exact reader node ID, with or without its GUID suffix; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Empty values, display labels and numeric indices are not supported.

parameters.name: PinName
parameters.description: Required exact input pin name from the reader; case-sensitive and not trimmed. The pin must be unconnected, non-execution, non-orphaned and accept editable defaults; empty is not a default selector.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Required literal in the pin type's Unreal schema format, for example 42 for an integer or true for a Boolean. Empty text is passed to the schema as a literal, not a universal reset command; acceptance depends on the pin type. No value is supplied automatically.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPPlayInput
tools.summary: Route bounded keyboard/gamepad input through Slate in PIE; executes game/UI code
tools.description: Route bounded keyboard/gamepad input through Slate in PIE; executes game/UI code. Delivery is not gameplay success. No Enhanced Input action injection, asset edits, save or undo. Use native Slate tools for mouse/text.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Exact session-bound token from ReadTurboMCPPlayInputState(Target=list), or pie:0 for a single PIE world/player. Tokens expire with the world/player. External-process clients are unsupported. Input scheduling is global: release the owning target before sending input to another target.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: activate, activate_gameplay, focus, hold, sequence or release. Activate requests OS foreground while preserving menu focus (may refuse; unattended guard refuses). activate_gameplay also moves Slate focus to the gameplay viewport in the same call and displaces menu focus; OS activation is still not guaranteed. Activation actions require empty Key, Value and Seconds. Focus moves Slate focus to the viewport, displacing menus. Hold/sequence preserve current PIE menu focus. Release cancels all owned inputs and pending events. Existing active input refuses.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Hold: keyboard/gamepad button or 1D axis. Sequence: JSON array, 1..32 events, sorted by at; fields at, key, duration, analog-only value. Example: [{"at":0,"key":"Gamepad_RightX","value":0.5,"duration":2},{"at":0.3,"key":"Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom","duration":0.1},{"at":0.8,"key":"Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom","duration":0.1}]. Distinct keys may overlap; same-key overlap and editor shortcuts refuse. Empty for other actions.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Hold axis: finite -1..1; empty otherwise. Stock Slate Gamepad_LeftY=-1 Down, +1 Up; magnitude >0.5. UI routing may differ. Example: hold Gamepad_LeftY, Value=-1, Seconds=0.3. Inspect actual focus; delivery is not success.

parameters.name: Seconds
parameters.description: Hold: finite 0.05..5; empty otherwise. Sequence at >=0 and duration 0.05..5, ending by 5 seconds. Normal ticks required; expired undispatched events abort, not replay. Focus loss, PIE end or deactivation release owned inputs. Holds may repeat, not exactly one row.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPPlayInvoke
tools.summary: Validate a scoped PIE runtime call and execute it once with preview confirmation
tools.description: Validate a scoped PIE runtime call and execute it once with preview confirmation. Reference-bearing parameters, RPCs and latent functions are refused. No save or undo guarantee.

parameters.name: WorldPath
parameters.description: Exact current PIE world object path.

parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description: Exact existing runtime object path in that world; local-player subsystems are supported.

parameters.name: FunctionName
parameters.description: Exact Blueprint-callable function name. Inspect ReadTurboMCPPlayFunction first.

parameters.name: Arguments
parameters.description: JSON object with every input parameter by exact name; use {} for no inputs. Use JSON numbers for numbers (integers must be exact and within +/-9007199254740991), booleans for bools, and strings for text/name/enum names. Arrays and sets use JSON arrays; reflected structs and maps use JSON objects. Map keys must be text/name/enum values. Object references, custom-imported structs and null values are unsupported. Supply all inputs, including defaults; omit output-only and return parameters. Example: {"Amount":3,"Label":"debug event"}. Unknown, missing or unsupported arguments refuse before dispatch.

parameters.name: Confirmation
parameters.description: Copy the preview confirmation with identical arguments within 120 seconds. It is consumed before invocation; never automatically retry.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPSave
tools.summary: Write named asset packages to disk, including packages whose dirty flag is clear; does not explicitly compile
tools.description: Write named asset packages to disk, including packages whose dirty flag is clear; does not explicitly compile. Widget Blueprints use direct package serialization without refreshing their thumbnail. Other assets use the editor save path, which may render thumbnails and execute asset code. Saving is not an undoable graph edit. Refuses during play, simulation or an active editor transaction. A refusal does not undo earlier edits or queue a save. Stop play and inspect ReadTurboMCPDirtyList before compiling and saving wanted changes. Each asset is saved separately, with one retry on failure; earlier writes are not rolled back if another asset fails. Source-control checkout results are reported and do not guarantee a lock or block the save. Inspect each result.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty lists and lists over 25 entries are refused. This is an explicit save list, not a dirty-asset filter.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPSaveWithoutThumbnail
tools.summary: Write named asset packages directly to disk without refreshing thumbnails; does not explicitly compile
tools.description: Write named asset packages directly to disk without refreshing thumbnails; does not explicitly compile. Skips the editor thumbnail draw, but package serialization still runs engine and asset save callbacks. This is not a sandbox or an undoable graph edit. Existing thumbnails may remain stale. Mounted package filenames must resolve successfully. Refuses during play, simulation or an active editor transaction. A refusal does not undo earlier edits or queue a save. Stop play and inspect ReadTurboMCPDirtyList before compiling and saving wanted changes. Saves each asset separately with one retry on failure; earlier writes are not rolled back. Source-control checkout results are reported, not a guarantee that a lock was acquired.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty lists and lists over 25 entries are refused. Explicitly saves even packages whose dirty flag is clear.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPStructFields
tools.summary: Add, change, reorder or remove struct fields in an undo transaction in an idle editor outside PIE; may check out files, compile structs and trigger dependent editor updates; removal or type changes may lose data; does not save
tools.description: Add, change, reorder or remove struct fields in an undo transaction in an idle editor outside PIE; may check out files, compile structs and trigger dependent editor updates; removal or type changes may lose data; does not save. Removal consent counts only loaded dependent assets, not all project references. Checkout failure is reported but does not block the in-memory edit. A failed operation may leave earlier changes applied; no automatic rollback is performed. Inspect the returned fields and dependent assets before saving.

parameters.name: Struct
parameters.description: Required user-defined struct asset name or package/object path, for example /Game/Structs/S_Item; empty or unresolved values and native C++ structs are refused.

parameters.name: Changes
parameters.description: Required comma-separated operations: Name: Type adds a missing field or changes an existing field; move:Name, above=Other or below=Other reorders; remove:Name deletes. Field declarations use the same types and default=, tooltip=, category= options as EditTurboMCPStructNew. Empty options leave existing settings unchanged, not cleared. Each field may be targeted once per call; empty input is refused. For removal, force=N must match the current loaded-dependent count reported by preview (integer 0 through 2147483647); omission is allowed only when there are no loaded dependents. Preview again if the count changes. Example: Count: int, default=1, move:Count, above=Label must be split into two calls because Count appears twice.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPStructNew
tools.summary: Create and compile a user-defined struct in memory within an undo transaction in an idle editor outside PIE; marks its package dirty and may run editor callbacks; does not save
tools.description: Create and compile a user-defined struct in memory within an undo transaction in an idle editor outside PIE; marks its package dirty and may run editor callbacks; does not save. Existing assets are refused. Preview validates field syntax and resolves types, but does not guarantee creation or validate every default. Edit lists observed fields; defaults and metadata are not fully verified. Failures may leave a partial unsaved asset; inspect before saving or retrying.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Required new package path including the asset name, such as /Game/Structs/S_Item; no object suffix or file extension. Whitespace is trimmed; empty, invalid and relative paths are refused. No automatic path is chosen.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Required comma-separated Name: Type declarations, such as Count: int, default=1, Label: text, tooltip=Item label. Options default=, tooltip= and category= attach to the preceding field and may appear once each. Empty input is refused; empty option values are skipped during creation. Names must be unique ignoring case. Types include bool, byte, int, int64, float, real, double, name, string, text; vector, rotator, transform, vector2d, linearcolor, color; loadable struct/enum paths; array<T>, set<T>, map<K,V>; a full class path denotes an object reference, for example Array</Script/Engine.SoundBase>. Nested containers are refused and set elements/map keys must be hashable. Use Unreal literal syntax for defaults; plain top-level commas delimit fields or options.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPTrace
tools.summary: Manage in-memory trace points; does not edit graph nodes, compile or save assets, and clearing recorded hits is not undoable
tools.description: Manage in-memory trace points; does not edit graph nodes, compile or save assets, and clearing recorded hits is not undoable. Arming registers IDs without verifying that the nodes exist or will emit trace events. It does not start gameplay. Hits require execution and available Blueprint instrumentation; zero hits do not prove that a node did not run.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Required command: arm, clear or status (case-insensitive). Empty is refused. Arm adds points; clear removes points and their recorded hits; status reports current trace state.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact node IDs from ReadTurboMCPNodeFind, e.g. Asset:EventGraph:NodeKey. Arm requires at least one; clear with empty removes ALL points and hits. Status ignores this argument. Supply an empty string when unused.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPVariableFlags
tools.summary: Edit flags on an existing owned member variable; preserves identity and graph references, without compile or save
tools.description: Edit flags on an existing owned member variable; preserves identity and graph references, without compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint path or unique name. Asset loading may run project callbacks.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive owned member name; inherited/native/component/widget-generated variables refuse.

parameters.name: InstanceEditable
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Controls per-instance editing, not Blueprint access.

parameters.name: ExposeOnSpawn
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Compile separately to update generated spawn behavior; inspect diagnostics before saving.

parameters.name: Private
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Blueprint access metadata, not a security boundary. External references are not validated. Specify at least one flag.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPVariableRemove
tools.summary: Remove one unused Blueprint-owned member variable after reference inspection; never deletes graph nodes intentionally
tools.description: Remove one unused Blueprint-owned member variable after reference inspection; never deletes graph nodes intentionally. Inspection loads dependent Blueprints and may run callbacks. Refuses referenced/inherited/generated variables and incomplete inspection. Dynamic/native/string references are outside proof. No save; structural refresh can compile dependencies and invalidate undo.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or unique name; prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive owned member name, not a local or widget-generated variable.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Copy the confirm token from preview. Missing or stale tokens refuse; references are checked again.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPVariableRename
tools.summary: Rename a member and supported getter/setter references using fresh confirmation; refreshes skeletons, so compile affected assets separately before saving
tools.description: Rename a member and supported getter/setter references using fresh confirmation; refreshes skeletons, so compile affected assets separately before saving. Preserves links, pin defaults, positions and OnRep association. Rechecks dependencies and defaults before editing. No save or checkout and no guaranteed undo across compilation. Unsupported cases refuse before mutation; see PreviewTurboMCPVariableRename.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Same Blueprint asset used for preview.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Same exact current member name used for preview.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Same new identifier used for preview.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Exact token from a fresh PreviewTurboMCPVariableRename result. Changed declarations, defaults, references or dependency coverage invalidate it.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPVarsAdd
tools.summary: Add Blueprint variables; may regenerate the skeleton repeatedly and run editor callbacks, can leave partial changes without rollback, and does not perform a full compile or save or create a dedicated undo transaction
tools.description: Add Blueprint variables; may regenerate the skeleton repeatedly and run editor callbacks, can leave partial changes without rollback, and does not perform a full compile or save or create a dedicated undo transaction. Preview does not resolve the target Blueprint or check existing names. Edit performs those checks; preview acceptance does not guarantee edit success. Defaults are validated as Unreal property text before adding any variables; compile separately before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty is refused. Preview only retains this identifier and does not check existing names; edit resolves it and checks conflicts.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Required comma-separated Name: Type declarations, e.g. Health: float default=100 category=Stats. Optional space-separated key=value fields: default (alias value), category, tooltip, private, readonly, instanceEditable, exposeOnSpawn. Flags default false and accept true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off. Other fields default empty; empty list is refused. Values cannot contain ungrouped spaces or commas. Types include basic scalars, named engine structs, enum/struct assets, object/class/softobject/softclass<ClassPath>, Array<T>, Set<T>, Map<K,V>; map values must be basic scalar types. Duplicate names/options are refused. Defaults are validated as Unreal property text before adding any variables; compile separately before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPVcsCheckout
tools.summary: Request provider checkout per asset; may contact the server and change source-control or file state, with no automatic rollback of partial success and no asset compile/save request
tools.description: Request provider checkout per asset; may contact the server and change source-control or file state, with no automatic rollback of partial success and no asset compile/save request. Provider results are reported per file; a successful command is not independent proof of an exclusive lock. Providers without checkout support may reject the request. Refresh with ReadTurboMCPVcsState afterward.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Assets must have files on disk. Empty reports provider status without checking out files. Invalid entries are reported individually; other entries may proceed.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetAdd
tools.summary: Add one designer widget at the end of a named panel using Unreal's palette operation
tools.description: Add one designer widget at the end of a named panel using Unreal's palette operation. Uses class defaults and a default parent slot. Requires an idle editor outside PIE. Refuses missing/full parents, name conflicts and circular widget dependencies. Native construction/palette hooks and structural refresh may run on edit; loaded dependent Blueprints may be affected. No full compile or save is requested. Read back, configure layout separately and compile before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required destination Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Parent
parameters.description: Required existing designer panel name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, such as CardList. Empty does not select or create a root. Named-slot insertion is not supported.

parameters.name: WidgetClass
parameters.description: Required compiled Widget Blueprint path/name, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Card, or concrete native class path such as /Script/UMG.TextBlock. Dirty source Blueprints must be compiled first.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required unused identifier: 1 to 100 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. Example: NewCard. Duplicate names refuse rather than adding a numbered copy.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetBindAdd
tools.summary: Add or replace a single-cast designer binding after checking the reflected function signature and property purity
tools.description: Add or replace a single-cast designer binding after checking the reflected function signature and property purity. No full compile, save or dedicated undo transaction. Invalid targets leave existing bindings intact. Identical requests return unchanged. Multicast events require graph binding tools instead.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Existing Widget Blueprint path or unique name, for example /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Existing widget name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree; matching ignores case.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Bindable property or single-cast delegate, for example Text or TextDelegate. Property aliases normalize to Text. Multicast OnClicked is refused.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: Existing reflected function, for example GetPurchaseText. Property getters must be pure or const and signature-compatible. Empty selects WidgetName_OnPropertyName but does not create that function. Compile first if reflection is stale.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetEvent
tools.summary: Edit a designer widget delegate event; returns pins and an existing/new node ID on edit, without compile or save
tools.description: Edit a designer widget delegate event; returns pins and an existing/new node ID on edit, without compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Widget Blueprint path or unique name. Loading can execute project callbacks. Requires idle editor and available undo for edits.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact owned K2 event graph name. Existing binding in another graph refuses; duplicate matching binding is a clean no-op returning its ID.

parameters.name: WidgetName
parameters.description: Exact owned designer widget name with Is Variable enabled and matching compiled skeleton property. Compile explicitly first if the property is missing/stale. Inherited widgets refuse.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: Exact BlueprintAssignable multicast delegate name on the widget class, e.g. OnClicked for UButton; not a display label. Return/writable-output signatures refuse. Connect the new event body separately, then compile and save explicitly. This differs from BindNewEvent on an existing runtime delegate input.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetProperty
tools.summary: Set one supported widget or parent-slot property in memory; returns before/after values read after native editor notification
tools.description: Set one supported widget or parent-slot property in memory; returns before/after values read after native editor notification. Uses an undo transaction. Reference validation may load the named asset and native hooks may run. No compile or save is requested; rendered/runtime behavior is not verified.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, not display text or a runtime instance path.

parameters.name: Target

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact name or dotted struct-field path returned by ReadTurboMCPWidgetProperty, for example Visibility, LayoutData, Brush.ResourceObject or EntryWidgetClass. Paths cannot descend objects or containers.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Required Unreal property text for values, or None/exact Unreal object or generated-class path for a hard reference. Asset type and field metadata are checked before mutation. Other struct fields are preserved. Maximum 65536 characters. Requires an idle editor outside PIE.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetRemove
tools.summary: Remove the widget subtree through the stock editor operation, with an undo transaction and structural refresh
tools.description: Remove the widget subtree through the stock editor operation, with an undo transaction and structural refresh. No full compile or save is requested. Refuses graph references, designer bindings, animation bindings and explicit navigation targets in this Blueprint. External assets, dynamic string lookups and custom reference systems are not verified. Removing the root leaves an empty tree. Edit checks current state again; loaded dependent Blueprints may be refreshed. Compile and inspect before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu. Requires an idle editor outside PIE and transactions.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required exact designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree. Includes its descendants in this tree, not the internals of embedded UserWidgets. Missing names refuse. Example: ObsoleteCard. Preview lists every affected name.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetRename
tools.summary: Rename an existing designer widget using Unreal's undoable editor operation
tools.description: Rename an existing designer widget using Unreal's undoable editor operation. Requires an idle editor outside PIE. Refreshes graph/designer references handled by Unreal, including bindings, animation names and navigation. Arbitrary string lookups and external assets are not verified. Structural refresh may affect loaded dependent Blueprints. No full compile or save is requested; inspect and compile before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required existing designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, not display text or a PIE instance path. Matching ignores case.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Required unused identifier: 1 to 100 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. Whitespace is trimmed; other invalid characters and member/name collisions refuse. Same name is a no-op; case-only renames are not supported. Example: PurchaseButton.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetRetarget
tools.summary: Remove bindings whose widget or delegate is missing without validating function signatures; changes stay in memory with no compile, save or dedicated undo transaction
tools.description: Remove bindings whose widget or delegate is missing without validating function signatures; changes stay in memory with no compile, save or dedicated undo transaction. Rechecks bindings before removal and reports remaining delegate failures. Keeps other bindings and leaves reported call nodes unchanged. Does not validate bound functions or signatures.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name, e.g. /Game/Tests/WBP_NodeTest. Empty, unresolved and non-Widget Blueprint assets are refused.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetSubtreeCopy
tools.summary: Copy one widget and its descendants into another Widget Blueprint
tools.description: Copy one widget and its descendants into another Widget Blueprint. Widget names must be unused unless AutoRename is enabled. Copies widget properties, internal slots and the root slot layout; preserves direct/struct/array text identities. Designer bindings refuse. Graph logic and animations are not copied. Detected references outside the selected subtree refuse; prefer copying a common ancestor. Complex custom widget references and text map/set properties are not fully validated. Read the target tree and compile before saving. Mutates the target in memory and requests structural refresh, which can compile dependencies. Does not save. Undo is not guaranteed across structural compilation. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: SourceWidget=PurchasePanel; Parent=RootCanvas; use exact source/target Widget Blueprint paths.

parameters.name: SourceAsset
parameters.description: Required source Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Prefer its full object path; the source is not edited.

parameters.name: SourceWidget
parameters.description: Required exact designer object name, such as PurchasePanel. Use the widget-tree reader; this is not displayed text or a runtime PIE path.

parameters.name: TargetAsset
parameters.description: Required different target Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Its parent class must equal or derive from the source parent class.

parameters.name: Parent
parameters.description: Required string naming an existing target panel, such as RootCanvas. Pass an empty string only when the target widget tree is empty. A panel must have room; its class must match the source parent class when preserving the root slot.

parameters.name: AutoRename
parameters.description: Optional, default false. Rename colliding copied widgets with _Copy, _Copy2, etc.; preview/edit list every mapping. The source and existing target widgets are untouched. Explicit navigation inside the subtree is remapped; outside navigation refuses. Graphs, animations and custom string references are not migrated. Edit recalculates names, so inspect its returned mapping. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: EditTurboMCPWidgetsAsVars
tools.summary: Set named widgets' Is Variable flags; changes may regenerate the Blueprint skeleton and run editor callbacks, do not perform a full compile or save, and have no dedicated undo transaction
tools.description: Set named widgets' Is Variable flags; changes may regenerate the Blueprint skeleton and run editor callbacks, do not perform a full compile or save, and have no dedicated undo transaction. Resolves all names before changing flags. Existing requested values are not counted as changes; names are deduplicated ignoring case. Disabling is refused for the whole request if self-variable getter/setter nodes in this Blueprint still reference a selected widget. External/dynamic references are not checked. Repair references first. This exposes existing widgets to graph logic; it does not create widgets, change appearance or connect nodes. Review the result, then use EditTurboMCPCompile and EditTurboMCPSave as needed.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/UI/WBP_Menu; empty is refused.

parameters.name: Widgets
parameters.description: Required widget names separated by commas or pipes, for example TitleText,BodyText; whitespace is trimmed, duplicates are ignored, and empty never means all widgets.

parameters.name: bIsVariable
parameters.description: Required boolean: true exposes the named widgets as variables; false removes that flag. No default is assumed.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPCapture
tools.summary: Capture a graph, asset editor, active window or live PIE game layer as a PNG. Start with Mode=graph for an overview
tools.description: Capture a graph, asset editor, active window or live PIE game layer as a PNG. Start with Mode=graph for an overview. ReadTurboMCPNodeFind supplies node IDs; then use Mode=node, Size=1200x800 for detail or Mode=neighbours, Size=1 for connected context. A fitted overview may make text too small to read. Inspect the image and request a smaller target; resolution and successful capture do not prove readability or graph correctness. Requires a rendered editor. May load assets and change editor view, focus or selection. Does not explicitly compile or save assets; editor callbacks may run. No automatic undo. All five string arguments are required. Pass empty strings for unused arguments.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Asset path or unique name. Required for graph and asset-editor captures. Empty for viewport; optional for screen.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name for graph modes. Asset-editor optionally accepts an editor kind; empty auto-detects. Empty for viewport; ignored by screen.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Case-insensitive. Graph modes: graph (default), node, box, region, selection, neighbours, box-neighbours. Other modes: screen, asset-editor, viewport. Diagnostics: debug-window, rhi-state, select-nodes (changes selection). Viewport supports one in-process PIE world only; inspect after normal game ticks.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Node ID for node/neighbours; zero-based comment index from LookTurboMCPLayoutReport for box/box-neighbours; x,y,width,height for region (finite, within +/-10000000, positive dimensions). Asset-editor: empty keeps the view, fit frames a Material graph. Viewport requires pie. select-nodes takes comma-separated node keys. Otherwise empty.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Graph/node/box/region: WxH or W,H, each 1..4096 pixels; empty means 1600x900. Selection/neighbours/box-neighbours: integer hop count 0..4096, empty means 0; image dimensions are automatic, not set by this number. Screen/asset-editor ignore Size. Viewport requires empty Size and uses native pixels up to a 4096-pixel edge. Diagnostics accept dimensions except rhi-state, which ignores Size.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPGraphPositions
tools.summary: Read node IDs, stored positions and measured sizes; loads the Blueprint and uses rendering without requesting graph edits, compile or save
tools.description: Read node IDs, stored positions and measured sizes; loads the Blueprint and uses rendering without requesting graph edits, compile or save. Positions are stored top-left coordinates; sizes are rendered node bodies in graph units, not screen pixels or wire bounds. Rendering measures the graph; NodeIds filters returned rows. Output reports selected, listed, omitted and excluded counts.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty or unresolved names are refused; list graphs with ReadTurboMCPBlueprintLoad first.

parameters.name: NodeIds
parameters.description: Optional newline-separated exact reader IDs or unique hexadecimal keys of at least six digits, maximum 256 entries. Empty selects all nodes. Missing, ambiguous or blank entries refuse the entire call. Duplicates are listed once.

parameters.name: MaxNodes
parameters.description: Optional output row limit, 1..256, default 128. Rows are sorted by ID and also bounded by the text budget. Continue with the returned next_offset until complete=true.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Optional zero-based row offset in the ID-sorted selection, default 0. Must be 0..selected count. Use the same selection across pages and restart at 0 after graph changes; offsets are not snapshot tokens.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPLayoutDoneCheck
tools.summary: Return layout findings and capture the same graph scope; may open editor UI and writes an image file, but does not request asset edits, compile or save
tools.description: Return layout findings and capture the same graph scope; may open editor UI and writes an image file, but does not request asset edits, compile or save. Requires rendering. This is a human review aid, not an automatic done/pass verdict. A capture failure remains visible alongside any successful text report. Native zoom can still refuse a large frame; select a node, box or smaller region instead.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. The same graph is measured and captured; empty or unresolved names are refused.

parameters.name: AlignmentTolerance
parameters.description: Optional finite vertical pin-offset tolerance in graph units, 0..1024; default 64. Use 8 for stricter review. Affects alignment findings, not capture framing, overlaps or backward-wire findings.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: Required string in the tool schema: pass an empty string for the whole graph, node:<reader ID or unique hex key>, box:<comment ID>, or region:x,y,width,height. A box captures its current rectangle; a node captures the resolved node. Invalid or ambiguous scopes refuse before capture. Report findings remain paged by LookTurboMCPLayoutReport defaults; use that tool for further pages.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPLayoutReport
tools.summary: Inspect graph geometry and layout findings; loads the Blueprint and measures Slate geometry without requesting graph edits, compile or save
tools.description: Inspect graph geometry and layout findings; loads the Blueprint and measures Slate geometry without requesting graph edits, compile or save. Requires editor rendering. Wire lengths use estimated pin positions, not rendered wire curves. Each finding is an intended control-flow handoff with rule R3/R4/R6, or a defect candidate needing visual review. An intended edge does not approve the whole layout. Cross-box wires remain candidates because a valid handoff may still cross unrelated boxes. Output is paged and some source lists are capped.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Required exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty or unresolved names are refused; use the Blueprint reader to list graphs.

parameters.name: AlignmentTolerance
parameters.description: Optional finite vertical pin-offset tolerance in graph units, 0..1024; default 64. Use 8 for stricter alignment review. Does not suppress overlaps or backward-wire findings. Values outside the range are refused.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: Required string: pass an empty string for the whole graph, or node:<reader ID or unique hex key>, box:<comment ID>, or region:x,y,width,height in graph units. The tool schema requires this field even for the whole graph. Box/region scopes include intersecting node rectangles, excluding edge-only contact. A finding is included if any involved node is selected, including links to outside nodes. Measurement still covers the graph.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Optional zero-based matched-finding offset, default 0. Use nextOffset from the response; -1 means complete. Pages are live; restart at 0 after edits.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Optional maximum whole findings per page, 1..120, default 120. Defect candidates appear before intended handoffs; overlaps lead the defect candidates. Text-budget limits never split a finding. Use targeted capture separately for visual review.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPToolset
tools.summary: Look for a live editor window that a capture could use
tools.description: Look for a live editor window that a capture could use. Answers one question: is there an editor window to look at right now. It reads the live Slate window list without capturing images or changing assets. Returns the total visible count and up to six titles. An unavailable Slate application is reported separately from zero windows. No image is captured.

tools.name: LookTurboMCPWidgetPreview
tools.summary: Render a Widget Blueprint with sample values and write a PNG. Pass the widget, sample values as a JSON object of variable name to value, an optional function to call after the values are set, and a size as WxH. Empty sample values means the widget's own defaults; an empty size means 1280x720
tools.description: Render a Widget Blueprint with sample values and write a PNG. Pass the widget, sample values as a JSON object of variable name to value, an optional function to call after the values are set, and a size as WxH. Empty sample values means the widget's own defaults; an empty size means 1280x720. A transient instance is made off screen, the values are set through reflection, the function is called, the widget is rendered into a render target and written to a PNG, and the instance is destroyed before the call returns. No play session is needed. Values are set with the engine's own text import, so the accepted spellings are the details panel's and not a format invented here. A variable name that does not exist is reported along with some names that do, rather than being ignored. A function that takes parameters is refused, because this tool has no way to supply them. The PNG goes to a fixed folder under the project's Saved folder, its alpha is forced opaque because a widget background is transparent by default, and every engine warning and error raised while setting values and rendering is reported. A widget with no generated class is refused, because an instance of it would not run its own Construct or its own functions. Execution is per-call consent: empty/deny refuses; allow permits project code. Script effects are not sandboxed or reversible, even without a named callback.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/WBP_NodeTest. Empty is refused; the widget needs a compiled generated class.

parameters.name: SampleValuesJson
parameters.description: JSON object encoded as a string, mapping variable names to values, e.g. {"Label":"Hello"}. Empty uses defaults. Values must be strings, numbers or booleans; structs/arrays use engine text-import strings. Nested JSON and null are refused before construction. Unknown variables are reported individually.

parameters.name: FunctionName
parameters.description: Optional zero-parameter widget function to execute after setting sample values and constructing the widget. Construction can overwrite samples; the callback runs afterwards. This does not simulate pointer or focus input. Empty skips the explicit callback; widget construction can still execute code.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Pixel dimensions as WxH or W,H, e.g. 1280x720. Empty defaults to 1280x720. Each dimension must contain digits only and be 1..4096; surrounding whitespace is accepted. Fractions, signs and oversized values are refused before construction.

parameters.name: Execution
parameters.description: Per-call consent: allow permits project code; empty or deny refuses before loading. Other values are refused. Defaults to deny; effects are not sandboxed or reversible.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPAssetDelete
tools.summary: Check one saved asset for deletion without deleting it; loading and garbage collection may run
tools.description: Check one saved asset for deletion without deleting it; loading and garbage collection may run. Refuses referenced, dirty, open, read-only or unsafe source-control targets, maps, redirectors and multi-asset packages. Never force-deletes or removes imported source files.

parameters.name: AssetPath
parameters.description: Exact saved /Game asset object path, for example /Game/Tests/Unused.Unused. No short names, folders or package-only paths.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPAssetRevert
tools.summary: Preview discarding all unsaved changes in a saved Blueprint or data-asset package; does not reload or save
tools.description: Preview discarding all unsaved changes in a saved Blueprint or data-asset package; does not reload or save. Returns a one-use confirmation valid for 60 seconds, bound to loaded package state and disk content. Refuses open asset editors, detected live-world references, PIE, active transactions and multiple top-level assets. The edit can reinstance references and reset global undo history; raw native references cannot all be detected.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required saved Blueprint or data-asset path, or unique short name. Prefer an exact path such as /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty, ambiguous, unsupported or unsaved assets are refused.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPAssetUndo
tools.summary: Inspect the latest global undo entry for the named Blueprint and return its confirmation GUID; does not undo
tools.description: Inspect the latest global undo entry for the named Blueprint and return its confirmation GUID; does not undo. Refuses unrelated or multi-package entries.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous values are refused; prefer the full path.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPBatchEdit
tools.summary: Simulate ordered repoints on a transient graph; loads the Blueprint without applying live edits, compiling or saving
tools.description: Simulate ordered repoints on a transient graph; loads the Blueprint without applying live edits, compiling or saving. All operations must target one asset and graph. Later plans see preceding simulated changes. Preview does not guarantee apply. Failed edits attempt owned undo and compare restored source state and the dirty flag; undo does not certify compilation. If restoration cannot be verified, further TurboMCP edit calls are blocked for the editor session. Inspect and recover the asset before restarting; do not save unverified changes.

parameters.name: Operations
parameters.description: Required nonempty JSON array of operation objects, or an object containing only a lowercase operations array. Each entry requires string asset, graphName (or graph, not both), sourceNodeId, sourcePin, targetNodeId and targetPin. Both pins are outputs. targetNodeId may be empty with targetTypeId for creation. Optional id defaults to operation-N and must be unique; kind defaults to exact graphRepoint, the only supported kind. Optional keepSource accepts boolean or true/false/1/0 text; empty or omitted retains the source. Other fields are strings. Operation field names are case-insensitive; unknown or case-duplicate fields refuse. Empty input/array and malformed JSON refuse. Example with actual reader IDs substituted: [{"asset":"/Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest","graphName":"EventGraph","sourceNodeId":"source reader ID","sourcePin":"ReturnValue","targetNodeId":"target reader ID","targetPin":"ReturnValue","keepSource":true}]. Both nodes must expose the named outputs.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPBindFunction
tools.summary: Preview connecting an existing function through a Create Event node on a transient graph; no live graph edits, compile or save
tools.description: Preview connecting an existing function through a Create Event node on a transient graph; no live graph edits, compile or save. Requires an idle editor. Preview exercises graph/schema callbacks on a copy; successful preview does not guarantee a later edit. Inspect the result and arrange new nodes before compiling and saving. Repeating the identical compatible function/object binding is unchanged. Replaced source nodes are retained and listed for inspection. This creates a delegate value; the owning Bind or Timer node must execute for registration. Read back, tidy the affected nodes, inspect a capture, then compile and save explicitly.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or ambiguous values are refused; prefer a full path.

parameters.name: GraphName

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPGraphAppend
tools.summary: Preview adding nodes without editing; Placement=local searches nearby; Placement=outside uses space beyond existing bounds and may create long wires
tools.description: Preview adding nodes without editing; Placement=local searches nearby; Placement=outside uses space beyond existing bounds and may create long wires. Placement=per-anchor places each disconnected component near its own fixed connection, preserving existing nodes; missing or conflicting anchors and blocked local space refuse. Use this before the edit. It reports every way the text cannot be applied, each naming its line, and it reports what WOULD be created - so a caller can see the change before agreeing to it. It adds nodes and links them to existing nodes BY NODE ID. It CANNOT REMOVE: the code path that would delete a node does not exist in this capability, which is what separates it from P-GRAPH-REPLACE. A form carrying a node id is read as a LINK to that node, never as a second copy of it. To connect two nodes created in one block, put `; label First` under the first form and write `(-> First:then)` in the second form's input pin. A local label is unique within that submitted block. Use writer node forms and explicit input links, checked by P-GRAPH-CHECK, so the edit rechecks the current graph and its mutation guards. Plans this operation without applying it to the target graph. A successful preview does not guarantee a later edit: the target state and edit guards can change. Local labels name the PRECEDING node form. Prefer `(TypeId) ; label Name` for a pinless node, or put `; label Name` on its own line after the closed form. Never put a label before its node. A multiline form may end with `Value 1) ; label Name`; one node cannot have conflicting labels. Quote creation IDs containing spaces: `("Exact Type ID")`. Use flat node forms, not nested reader values. Flat example: `(TypeId` then `InputPin 1) ; label ValueNode`, followed by a separate consumer form containing `DestinationInput (-> ValueNode:OutputPin)`. Substitute discovered type IDs and pin names. Do not write `(TypeId ; label Name)` on one line: the comment hides its closing parenthesis. Every link is written on its destination INPUT: InputPin (-> SourceId:OutputPin). Whitespace-only pin names are quoted exactly as shown by NodePins: `" " (-> Source:" ")`. Preserve the spaces inside those quotes; they are engine pin names, not missing values. To feed an existing node, copy its reader form header with its node ID, then add that input link. Do not write a reverse link on a source output pin. Discover creation IDs with PreviewTurboMCPNodeType; use PreviewTurboMCPNodePins for exact pin names. Native engine search IDs are not interchangeable. In a function graph, use Function|Result for another Return; link execute from a reachable branch and set or link its result inputs. Reader branch headings (:then/:else) are read-only and are refused. They do not create wires. Instead, label the Branch Choice and write `execute (-> Choice:then)` inside the destination node form (or Choice:else for the false output). Use the exact pin names from discovery. Reference it as `(-> Name:ExactPinName)`. A pinless form needs no dummy pin. Semicolon comments consume the rest of their line: put the closing parenthesis BEFORE a trailing label/comment. Continuation: auto (legacy unique exit), all (all reachable new unconnected exec exits), or label:pin (one named new node output). Applies to displaced existing exec wires; explicit submitted target links take precedence. Compile/save deferred.

Connected append placement searches nearby space above and below fixed connections. In local mode, existing nodes stay fixed. If no local slot fits, free space or submit a smaller connected block. Tight gaps may require bent wires; this is not whole-graph tidy.

tools.description: Change only what changed: name existing nodes by id and give the pins that differ. Read the graph first, then submit ONLY the nodes whose pin values you want to change, each with its node id from the reader. Nodes you do not mention are LEFT ALONE, and it counts and names the nodes it would change - which is the number that matters, because a patch that touches a third node has failed even when the graph still compiles. It CHANGES and does not ADD or REMOVE. A form with no node id is refused and told which tool adds nodes, because "applies only the differences" is not "adds a block" - that is P/E-GRAPH-APPEND - and removing is P/E-GRAPH-REPLACE. A form that names a node but writes no pin value changes nothing, and is refused rather than reported as a change of zero. Returns the nodes that would change, each by key with its class, and the count of nodes named against the count that would actually differ. Writes nothing, and cannot. tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPGraphTidy
tools.summary: Plan a layout for one graph without committing graph changes
tools.description: Plan a layout for one graph without committing graph changes. Measures native node geometry. Within safety limits, structural quality takes priority over total wire length. Unsupported graphs or unavailable measured geometry are refused rather than estimated. The edit recomputes its plan against current state. Tidy may duplicate variable getters near their consumers; it does not create local variables. Inspect the preview and resulting capture: numeric layout scores do not prove human readability. NodeIds accepts "@unboxed": alone selects all unboxed nodes; with node IDs filters that selection to unboxed nodes. Boxed nodes and comments stay fixed. `NodeIds` scopes the pass to a block. An empty list tidies the whole graph; otherwise every unselected node is a fixed anchor and only the named nodes may move. The block is moved to clear space rather than through its anchors. The preview reports the planned score and the edit reports the score it actually measured after writing. WrapAfter optionally lists comma-separated execution node IDs at natural breaks (e.g. a latent call); their continuations start a new row. No links change. HorizontalGap/VerticalGap set full-detail clearance; LanePitch is minimum Sequence row spacing, expanded for tall pure trees. MainPath accepts "auto" for the longest acyclic execution path, or comma-separated connected reader node IDs for the top exec lane. Auto refuses unsupported execution cycles. Structural quality (including requested row breaks) takes priority; total wire length breaks ties.

Unsupported cycles are refused in auto mode. With NodeIds selection, only the first explicit path node may be outside the selection: it stays fixed and must connect to the next selected node. All later path nodes must be selected.
