parameters.description: JSON object mapping exact output IDs from the local-variable preview to meaningful local names, for example {"<exact output ID>":"Subtotal"}. A nonempty map selects only its exact output IDs. Default {} preserves automatic selection of reviewed entry-stable arithmetic; input-array counts and loop values always require explicit selection. Unknown IDs, invalid names and name collisions are refused. Use the same mapping for preview and edit.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPMaterialBlocks
tools.summary: Plan material label and reroute cleanup using the loaded graph
tools.description: Plan material label and reroute cleanup using the loaded graph. Does not compile, change graph data or save. Uses existing comment boxes as blocks. Adds labels for values read by multiple blocks, merges repeated usages per block, and removes eligible internal reroutes. Existing node positions are preserved; new usages need free space inside their block. This is cleanup, not full graph layout. Edit rebuilds the plan from current state; request another preview if the material changed. Compile and identity checks do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances and material functions are refused. For an instance, explicitly name its parent material. Blocks are existing comment boxes; this tool does not create boxes or perform a full graph layout.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPMaterialLabelPromote
tools.summary: Plan named reroutes for exact material outputs read by multiple expressions
tools.description: Plan named reroutes for exact material outputs read by multiple expressions. Loads the Material but does not compile, change connections or save. Material functions and instances are refused. Names use parameter/caption and output context. One exact output and mask must have at least two distinct direct readers; existing named-reroute readers are left alone. Existing positions are preserved; new nodes use conservative collision bounds, not full graph tidy or comment containment. Edit replans current state and compiles only when changing it. Compiler and identity checks do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances are refused; explicitly name the parent to edit its graph.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPMaterialTidy
tools.summary: Plan material positions and descriptive column boxes; does not compile, apply layout or save; accepts Materials only, not functions or instances
tools.description: Plan material positions and descriptive column boxes; does not compile, apply layout or save; accepts Materials only, not functions or instances. Uses estimated expression sizes. Matching expression identities and compile errors do not prove identical rendered output.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required material name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Surface; empty is refused. Material instances are refused; name their parent explicitly.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Legacy compatibility string; leave empty. Layout is always recomputed and an already matching result remains unchanged, including when Force is nonempty.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPMergeMembers
tools.summary: Prepare missing member declarations before copying graph bodies between Blueprints
tools.description: Prepare missing member declarations before copying graph bodies between Blueprints. Creates declared variables with defaults, function signatures, dispatcher signatures and custom-event declarations on a new named event graph. Exact-name exclusions skip creation without deleting existing target members. GraphTransfer can replace matching empty event declarations with their bodies; connected or commented target events refuse. Compatible existing members are retained; differing variable types or callable signatures refuse. Compile both assets first. Does not copy widget trees, interfaces, function bodies, animations or bindings. Add required interfaces and copy widget subtrees separately, then use GraphTransfer. A failed edit can leave earlier declarations created; inspect the target before retrying. Preview only: may load assets but does not edit them. An unchanged response means no work is needed. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: SourceAsset=/Game/UI/WBP_Source.WBP_Source; TargetAsset=/Game/UI/WBP_Target.WBP_Target.

parameters.name: SourceAsset
parameters.description: Required source Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Prefer its full object path; the source is not edited.

parameters.name: TargetAsset
parameters.description: Required different target Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Its parent class must equal or derive from the source parent class.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional comma- or pipe-separated exact source member names to skip, case-insensitive. Empty includes all. Unknown names refuse before changes. Skipped dependencies may need separate preparation before transferring bodies. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPNodePinGrowth
tools.summary: Preview growth of variadic pins on Make Array, Sequence or associative operators; does not shrink, compile or save
tools.description: Preview growth of variadic pins on Make Array, Sequence or associative operators; does not shrink, compile or save. Workflow: append a base node, read its ID, preview/grow, then connect new pins explicitly. Existing pins and links are preserved. No shrink, compile or save. An equal target is a clean no-op.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint asset path or unique name. Loading may execute project callbacks.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name in the Blueprint.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Exact full reader ID of the existing supported node.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Desired total, decimal integer 1..32. Sequence counts output branches; array/operator counts inputs. Unsupported native limits refuse.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPNodePins
tools.summary: Inspect pins by constructing a temporary node; loads assets and executes editor probe code, without requesting compilation or saving
tools.description: Inspect pins by constructing a temporary node; loads assets and executes editor probe code, without requesting compilation or saving. Reports pin directions, defaults and graph restrictions; this is not proof of runtime behavior or absence of all side effects.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty selects the Blueprint event graph; missing or ambiguous graphs are refused.

parameters.name: TypeId
parameters.description: Required exact, case-sensitive ID returned by PreviewTurboMCPNodeType. Copy the complete ID; empty or approximate names are refused. For Function|Result, the temporary probe mirrors the function's existing Return output pins; it leaves the live graph unchanged.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPNodeType
tools.summary: Search available node types; loads Blueprint context and queries editor node actions, without requesting graph edits, compilation or saving
tools.description: Search available node types; loads Blueprint context and queries editor node actions, without requesting graph edits, compilation or saving. Results are ranked and capped; PreviewTurboMCPNodePins inspects a returned type. Searches include member getter/setter terms, arithmetic words such as plus/minus, and reflected dispatcher names. Check the declaring class before binding an event; similarly named dispatchers can belong to different classes. Discovery does not prove that a target-object pin connection is compatible. Use the returned exact creation ID. In function graphs, Function|Result creates another Return using the existing function output signature.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved input is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty selects the Blueprint event graph; missing or ambiguous graphs are refused.

parameters.name: Words
parameters.description: Search text or candidate type ID, e.g. PrintString. Empty is allowed only with an explicit Limit for bounded browsing.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum results as digits from 1 to 200, e.g. 10. Empty defaults to 10; signs, fractions, zero and larger values are refused.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPOverrideAdd
tools.summary: Preview an event or function override; loads the Blueprint and inspects editor metadata without creating the override, compiling or saving
tools.description: Preview an event or function override; loads the Blueprint and inspects editor metadata without creating the override, compiling or saving. Existing implementations are reported; edit will return unchanged without creating a duplicate. Preview is not a reservation; edit checks again. Edit creates only the override entry, not its behavior, and reports its exact node ID and graph. Connect the body, inspect parent-call requirements and tidy affected nodes before compiling.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, for example /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty is refused.

parameters.name: FunctionOrEvent
parameters.description: Required reflected name from ReadTurboMCPOverrides, for example ReceiveActorOnClicked; case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace trimmed. Empty or unavailable names are refused; no default.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPPlayInvoke
tools.summary: Validate a scoped PIE runtime call without executing it
tools.description: Validate a scoped PIE runtime call without executing it. Reference-bearing parameters, RPCs and latent functions are refused. No save or undo guarantee.

parameters.name: WorldPath
parameters.description: Exact current PIE world object path.

parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description: Exact existing runtime object path in that world; local-player subsystems are supported.

parameters.name: FunctionName
parameters.description: Exact Blueprint-callable function name. Inspect ReadTurboMCPPlayFunction first.

parameters.name: Arguments
parameters.description: JSON object with every input parameter by exact name; use {} for no inputs. Use JSON numbers for numbers (integers must be exact and within +/-9007199254740991), booleans for bools, and strings for text/name/enum names. Arrays and sets use JSON arrays; reflected structs and maps use JSON objects. Map keys must be text/name/enum values. Object references, custom-imported structs and null values are unsupported. Supply all inputs, including defaults; omit output-only and return parameters. Example: {"Amount":3,"Label":"debug event"}. Unknown, missing or unsupported arguments refuse before dispatch.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPStructFields
tools.summary: Inspect proposed struct field edits; loads the struct and referenced types and queries source-control status; does not edit, compile, check out or save the struct
tools.description: Inspect proposed struct field edits; loads the struct and referenced types and queries source-control status; does not edit, compile, check out or save the struct. Removal consent counts only loaded dependent assets, not all project references. Checkout failure is reported but does not block the in-memory edit. A failed operation may leave earlier changes applied; no automatic rollback is performed. Inspect the returned fields and dependent assets before saving.

parameters.name: Struct
parameters.description: Required user-defined struct asset name or package/object path, for example /Game/Structs/S_Item; empty or unresolved values and native C++ structs are refused.

parameters.name: Changes
parameters.description: Required comma-separated operations: Name: Type adds a missing field or changes an existing field; move:Name, above=Other or below=Other reorders; remove:Name deletes. Field declarations use the same types and default=, tooltip=, category= options as EditTurboMCPStructNew. Empty options leave existing settings unchanged, not cleared. Each field may be targeted once per call; empty input is refused. For removal, force=N must match the current loaded-dependent count reported by preview (integer 0 through 2147483647); omission is allowed only when there are no loaded dependents. Preview again if the count changes. Example: Count: int, default=1, move:Count, above=Label must be split into two calls because Count appears twice.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPStructNew
tools.summary: Inspect a proposed user-defined struct; type resolution may load referenced assets; does not create, compile or save the struct
tools.description: Inspect a proposed user-defined struct; type resolution may load referenced assets; does not create, compile or save the struct. Existing assets are refused. Preview validates field syntax and resolves types, but does not guarantee creation or validate every default. Edit lists observed fields; defaults and metadata are not fully verified. Failures may leave a partial unsaved asset; inspect before saving or retrying.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Required new package path including the asset name, such as /Game/Structs/S_Item; no object suffix or file extension. Whitespace is trimmed; empty, invalid and relative paths are refused. No automatic path is chosen.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Required comma-separated Name: Type declarations, such as Count: int, default=1, Label: text, tooltip=Item label. Options default=, tooltip= and category= attach to the preceding field and may appear once each. Empty input is refused; empty option values are skipped during creation. Names must be unique ignoring case. Types include bool, byte, int, int64, float, real, double, name, string, text; vector, rotator, transform, vector2d, linearcolor, color; loadable struct/enum paths; array<T>, set<T>, map<K,V>; a full class path denotes an object reference, for example Array</Script/Engine.SoundBase>. Nested containers are refused and set elements/map keys must be hashable. Use Unreal literal syntax for defaults; plain top-level commas delimit fields or options.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPToolset
tools.summary: Report registered schema sizes without invoking tools or changing assets
tools.description: Report registered schema sizes without invoking tools or changing assets. Returns the total schema characters across all registered toolsets, then the size of each registered TurboMCP toolset or its missing-registration notice. Whole-toolset sizes are not compared with the 2000-character compact-help budget. This is metadata inspection, not an edit preview or image capture.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPVariableFlags
tools.summary: Preview flags on an existing owned member variable; preserves identity and graph references, without compile or save
tools.description: Preview flags on an existing owned member variable; preserves identity and graph references, without compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint path or unique name. Asset loading may run project callbacks.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive owned member name; inherited/native/component/widget-generated variables refuse.

parameters.name: InstanceEditable
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Controls per-instance editing, not Blueprint access.

parameters.name: ExposeOnSpawn
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Compile separately to update generated spawn behavior; inspect diagnostics before saving.

parameters.name: Private
parameters.description: Exact true/false; empty preserves. Blueprint access metadata, not a security boundary. External references are not validated. Specify at least one flag.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPVariableRemove
tools.summary: Remove one unused Blueprint-owned member variable after reference inspection; never deletes graph nodes intentionally
tools.description: Remove one unused Blueprint-owned member variable after reference inspection; never deletes graph nodes intentionally. Inspection loads dependent Blueprints and may run callbacks. Refuses referenced/inherited/generated variables and incomplete inspection. Dynamic/native/string references are outside proof. No save; structural refresh can compile dependencies and invalidate undo.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or unique name; prefer the full path.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive owned member name, not a local or widget-generated variable.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPVariableRename
tools.summary: Preview an owned member-variable rename and list affected Blueprint assets and getter/setter references
tools.description: Preview an owned member-variable rename and list affected Blueprint assets and getter/setter references. Preserves identity, effective default and replication association. May load dependent Blueprints, but never maps; preview does not edit or compile. Incomplete discovery, child-name collisions, unsupported bindings/reference nodes and child default overrides refuse. Dynamic/native references are outside inspection. No save or checkout.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Blueprint asset path or unique name; prefer a full object path.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive owned member name. Inherited, local, component and widget-generated variables are not supported.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: New valid member identifier. Case-only renames are refused. Copy the returned confirmation token to EditTurboMCPVariableRename.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPVarsAdd
tools.summary: Parse a variable creation request; may load referenced types but does not add variables, compile the target or save
tools.description: Parse a variable creation request; may load referenced types but does not add variables, compile the target or save. Preview does not resolve the target Blueprint or check existing names. Edit performs those checks; preview acceptance does not guarantee edit success. Defaults are validated as Unreal property text before adding any variables; compile separately before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint name or package/object path, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest; empty is refused. Preview only retains this identifier and does not check existing names; edit resolves it and checks conflicts.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Required comma-separated Name: Type declarations, e.g. Health: float default=100 category=Stats. Optional space-separated key=value fields: default (alias value), category, tooltip, private, readonly, instanceEditable, exposeOnSpawn. Flags default false and accept true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off. Other fields default empty; empty list is refused. Values cannot contain ungrouped spaces or commas. Types include basic scalars, named engine structs, enum/struct assets, object/class/softobject/softclass<ClassPath>, Array<T>, Set<T>, Map<K,V>; map values must be basic scalar types. Duplicate names/options are refused. Defaults are validated as Unreal property text before adding any variables; compile separately before saving.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPVcsCheckout
tools.summary: Inspect checkout eligibility; refreshes provider state and may contact the server, but does not request checkout, asset compilation or saving
tools.description: Inspect checkout eligibility; refreshes provider state and may contact the server, but does not request checkout, asset compilation or saving. This is a current-state report, not a reservation or guarantee that a later checkout will succeed.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Assets must have files on disk. Empty reports provider status only. Each unresolved asset is reported separately.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetAdd
tools.summary: Preview adding a designer widget; loads classes but constructs no widget and makes no explicit edit
tools.description: Preview adding a designer widget; loads classes but constructs no widget and makes no explicit edit. Requires an idle editor outside PIE. Refuses missing/full parents, name conflicts and circular widget dependencies. Native construction/palette hooks and structural refresh may run on edit; loaded dependent Blueprints may be affected. No full compile or save is requested. Read back, configure layout separately and compile before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required destination Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Parent
parameters.description: Required existing designer panel name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, such as CardList. Empty does not select or create a root. Named-slot insertion is not supported.

parameters.name: WidgetClass
parameters.description: Required compiled Widget Blueprint path/name, such as /Game/UI/WBP_Card, or concrete native class path such as /Script/UMG.TextBlock. Dirty source Blueprints must be compiled first.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required unused identifier: 1 to 100 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. Example: NewCard. Duplicate names refuse rather than adding a numbered copy.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetEvent
tools.summary: Preview a designer widget delegate event; returns pins and an existing/new node ID on edit, without compile or save
tools.description: Preview a designer widget delegate event; returns pins and an existing/new node ID on edit, without compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Widget Blueprint path or unique name. Loading can execute project callbacks. Requires idle editor and available undo for edits.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact owned K2 event graph name. Existing binding in another graph refuses; duplicate matching binding is a clean no-op returning its ID.

parameters.name: WidgetName
parameters.description: Exact owned designer widget name with Is Variable enabled and matching compiled skeleton property. Compile explicitly first if the property is missing/stale. Inherited widgets refuse.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: Exact BlueprintAssignable multicast delegate name on the widget class, e.g. OnClicked for UButton; not a display label. Return/writable-output signatures refuse. Connect the new event body separately, then compile and save explicitly. This differs from BindNewEvent on an existing runtime delegate input.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetProperty
tools.summary: Validate and preview one widget or parent-slot property; returns before/after values without changing the widget
tools.description: Validate and preview one widget or parent-slot property; returns before/after values without changing the widget. Exact hard reference validation can load the named asset and run native load hooks. Compile/save and rendered/runtime verification are separate.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, not display text or a runtime instance path.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Required widget or slot. Slot means the named widget's parent slot; a root without a slot refuses.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact name or dotted struct-field path returned by ReadTurboMCPWidgetProperty, for example Visibility, LayoutData, Brush.ResourceObject or EntryWidgetClass. Paths cannot descend objects or containers.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Required Unreal property text for values (for example Hidden), or None/exact Unreal object or generated-class path for a hard reference. The referenced asset must exist and satisfy the field's type and metadata constraints. Other struct fields are preserved. Maximum 65536 characters. Requires an idle editor outside PIE.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetRemove
tools.summary: Preview removal; no mutation is performed
tools.description: Preview removal; no mutation is performed. Refuses graph references, designer bindings, animation bindings and explicit navigation targets in this Blueprint. External assets, dynamic string lookups and custom reference systems are not verified. Removing the root leaves an empty tree. Edit checks current state again; loaded dependent Blueprints may be refreshed. Compile and inspect before saving.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu. Requires an idle editor outside PIE and transactions.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required exact designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree. Includes its descendants in this tree, not the internals of embedded UserWidgets. Missing names refuse. Example: ObsoleteCard. Preview lists every affected name.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetRetarget
tools.summary: Inspect widget bindings for missing widgets or delegates without validating function signatures, removing bindings, compiling or saving
tools.description: Inspect widget bindings for missing widgets or delegates without validating function signatures, removing bindings, compiling or saving. Reports stale call nodes without editing them. Delegate presence does not validate the bound function or its signature.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name, e.g. /Game/Tests/WBP_NodeTest. Empty, unresolved and non-Widget Blueprint assets are refused.

tools.name: PreviewTurboMCPWidgetSubtreeCopy
tools.summary: Copy one widget and its descendants into another Widget Blueprint
tools.description: Copy one widget and its descendants into another Widget Blueprint. Widget names must be unused unless AutoRename is enabled. Copies widget properties, internal slots and the root slot layout; preserves direct/struct/array text identities. Designer bindings refuse. Graph logic and animations are not copied. Detected references outside the selected subtree refuse; prefer copying a common ancestor. Complex custom widget references and text map/set properties are not fully validated. Read the target tree and compile before saving. Preview only: may load assets but does not edit them. An unchanged response means no work is needed. Requires the editor game thread outside PIE and active transactions. Example: SourceWidget=PurchasePanel; Parent=RootCanvas; use exact source/target Widget Blueprint paths.

parameters.name: SourceAsset
parameters.description: Required source Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Prefer its full object path; the source is not edited.

parameters.name: SourceWidget
parameters.description: Required exact designer object name, such as PurchasePanel. Use the widget-tree reader; this is not displayed text or a runtime PIE path.

parameters.name: TargetAsset
parameters.description: Required different target Blueprint asset path or unambiguous name. Its parent class must equal or derive from the source parent class.

parameters.name: Parent
parameters.description: Required string naming an existing target panel, such as RootCanvas. Pass an empty string only when the target widget tree is empty. A panel must have room; its class must match the source parent class when preserving the root slot.

parameters.name: AutoRename
parameters.description: Optional, default false. Rename colliding copied widgets with _Copy, _Copy2, etc.; preview/edit list every mapping. The source and existing target widgets are untouched. Explicit navigation inside the subtree is remapped; outside navigation refuses. Graphs, animations and custom string references are not migrated. Edit recalculates names, so inspect its returned mapping. @return A preview/edited/unchanged summary or an error with the reason. Structural refresh is not proof of successful compilation. Read back and compile before saving.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPAssetCost
tools.summary: Report recorded package disk sizes and direct registry dependencies; does not explicitly edit, compile or save assets
tools.description: Report recorded package disk sizes and direct registry dependencies; does not explicitly edit, compile or save assets. This is not runtime memory, cooked size or recursive load cost. Categories may overlap; unknown sizes remain unknown. Registry data may omit unsaved or dynamic references.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required asset path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or unresolved assets are refused. Use a full path to disambiguate.

parameters.name: Cap
parameters.description: Required integer maximum rows in each contributor and unknown-size list. Zero or negative uses 10; positive values are used directly. Example: 20. Does not limit dependency scanning or category counts; omitted rows are reported.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPAssetDescribe
tools.summary: Read what one or more assets are, in any path form
tools.description: Read what one or more assets are, in any path form. Pass assets separated by commas or pipes. Every form resolves: a short name, a package path, an object path, or a generated class path. A short name that fits more than one asset is refused with the full list rather than guessed at. Each answer gives the package path, object path, class, generated class path when the asset has one, parent for a Blueprint, whether the asset is loaded, whether it has unsaved changes, and whether it is on disk. A fact that could not be read is reported as unknown with the reason, never as a confident answer (`D-05`).

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: One or more existing assets separated by commas or pipes, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Short names must resolve uniquely; use full paths to disambiguate.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPAssetSearch
tools.summary: Read assets matching a query, like the editor's quick open search
tools.description: Read assets matching a query, like the editor's quick open search. For gameplay-tag usage/referencers, discover the stock GameplayTagsToolset FindReferencersByTag tool and pass tagName (the exact registered tag). It returns asset-registry package referencers, not proof of runtime execution. This text search is not a tag-reference search; the stock toolset must be enabled. Pass words to match against asset names and folder paths. Every word must appear in one or the other. The query filters type: and path: match substrings in the class name and package folder respectively. Path limits the search to an exact folder and, by default, its subfolders. Query filters also apply within that scope. Ranking is exact name first, then names that start with the words, then names that contain them, then folder only matches, and shorter names first on a tie. Searches registry data, including registered unsaved assets, without loading or editing assets. Shows at most 40 matches and reports omissions.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Search words with optional type: and path: substring filters, e.g. type:Blueprint menu. Pass an empty string to list matches within Path.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Optional full mounted content folder, e.g. /Game/UI. Omit or pass * or an empty string for an unscoped search. A single trailing slash is accepted.

parameters.name: Recursive
parameters.description: Include subfolders when Path is set. Default true. Set false for assets directly in Path.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPBPLint
tools.summary: Inspect Blueprints for selected lint findings; loads assets but does not explicitly edit, compile or save them
tools.description: Inspect Blueprints for selected lint findings; loads assets but does not explicitly edit, compile or save them. Findings are review suggestions, not proof of defects or guaranteed fixes.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma-separated Blueprint paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty is refused except when Checks=list. Each asset is processed independently; failures are reported alongside successful results.

parameters.name: Checks
parameters.description: Required comma-separated check names; empty runs all checks. list returns names and descriptions without loading assets. Example: dead-nodes,unconnected-pins. Unknown names are refused.

parameters.name: TokenBudget
parameters.description: Required string of decimal digits from 0 to 2147483647. Empty or 0 disables the budget. Positive values bound finding text approximately at four characters per estimated token per asset; complete lines may exceed it. Counts and headings are outside this budget. Example: 2000. Fractions and signs are refused.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPBlueprintLoad
tools.summary: Inspect Blueprint structure and selected graph content; loads assets without requesting edits, compile or save
tools.description: Inspect Blueprint structure and selected graph content; loads assets without requesting edits, compile or save. This is not a complete export or proof of runtime behavior. Relation analysis is static; omitted content and budget refusals are reported. Widget details are included only for unfiltered text reads above manifest detail.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated list of 1..8 Blueprint paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty input is refused. Per-asset failures do not discard other results. Split the list into smaller calls or read one asset per call if the combined response exceeds the client's capacity.

parameters.name: Detail
parameters.description: Optional string (default manifest): manifest, signatures, bodies or full (case-insensitive). Empty uses manifest. Higher levels add signatures/relations, graph bodies, then editing details; oversized documents are refused without lowering detail. Text relations distinguish explicit setters, stock container mutation sites and possible non-const reference writes; tracing follows getters through reroutes, not arbitrary aliases.

parameters.name: GraphFilter
parameters.description: Optional; * (default) or empty selects all graphs. Comma- or pipe-separated graph-name fragments. Empty selects all local graphs; otherwise any case-insensitive substring match is included. No match produces a per-asset refusal listing graph names. Filters graph names, signatures, relations and directly referenced variable/component declarations. Asset identity, parent and interfaces remain asset-level context; filtered reads do not establish whole-asset nonuse.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Optional string (default read): read or json (case-insensitive); empty uses read. JSON is embedded per asset in a text response with headings/status, not returned as one standalone JSON document. Both formats support all detail levels.

parameters.name: TokenBudget
parameters.description: Optional string (default 60000) of positive decimal digits, up to 2147483647; empty uses 60000. This limits each asset document in characters. Several asset documents and response headings can together exceed this value. Text and JSON refuse oversized documents with the required character count while preserving requested detail. Raise TokenBudget to that count as a decimal string, narrow GraphFilter, or use ReadTurboMCPGraphLoad for paged graph reads.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPBulkExport
tools.summary: Export bounded pages from one bulk reader into a single JSON report under Saved/TurboMCP/Exports
tools.description: Export bounded pages from one bulk reader into a single JSON report under Saved/TurboMCP/Exports. Writes a report file, never saves project assets. Package loads may run PostLoad and dirty assets; original reader safety checks and per-page effects are preserved. Complete is false for skipped assets, capped evidence, errors or limits. Time is checked between pages, not during a load.

parameters.name: Reader
parameters.description: Exact ReadTurboMCPRefsBatch, ReadTurboMCPNodeFind or ReadTurboMCPWidgetInventory.

parameters.name: QueryJSON
parameters.description: Reader arguments as one JSON object using lower-camel names. Omit cursor and format; export starts at the first page and forces NodeFind JSON. Unknown fields are refused.

parameters.name: MaxPages
parameters.description: Maximum pages, 1..1000. Default 100. A partial report retains its nextCursor.

parameters.name: MaxSeconds
parameters.description: Time budget checked between pages, 1..120. Default 30. A single page can exceed it.

parameters.name: MaxMegabytes
parameters.description: Maximum UTF-8 report size, 1..64. Default 16. No arbitrary output path or overwrite.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPCallCost
tools.summary: Summarize retained call costs, durations and failures
tools.description: Summarize retained call costs, durations and failures. Does not clear the log or change recording settings; this request may itself be recorded. Related records are grouped into calls. Rankings and totals cover matching retained calls, not all historical activity. Unknown measurements are not zero; token counts are estimates.

parameters.name: Since
parameters.description: Required timestamp string copied exactly from a log entry, e.g. 2026-10-24T09:30:00.000Z. Empty has no lower bound. Selects calls strictly after the timestamp using text comparison; other date formats are not normalized or validated.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Required string. Case-insensitive substring of the tool label, toolset, tool or source; e.g. TurboMCPReadToolset. Empty includes all retained calls. Unlike CallLog, does not search arguments or status.

parameters.name: Cap
parameters.description: Required string of positive decimal digits, e.g. 10. Empty uses 10; values above 50 are capped at 50. Limits displayed rows per list, not analysis or totals. Zero, signs and fractions are refused.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPCallLog
tools.summary: Read retained call-log records, newest first
tools.description: Read retained call-log records, newest first. Does not clear the log or change recording settings; this request may itself be recorded. Engine records may lack arguments or resolved names. Unknown sizes are not zero. Arguments and results are escaped single-line excerpts capped at 200 characters with an explicit truncation marker. Records are not the same as completed calls; use ReadTurboMCPCallCost for call totals.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Required string. Case-insensitive substring of toolset, tool, source, arguments or status (ok/error/incomplete). Empty matches all records; e.g. BP_NodeTest. This call can match its own recorded filter argument.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Required string of positive decimal digits, e.g. 50. Empty uses 50; values above 500 are capped at 500. Zero, signs and fractions are refused.

parameters.name: Since
parameters.description: Required timestamp string copied exactly from a log entry, e.g. 2026-10-24T09:30:00.000Z. Empty has no lower bound. Returns records strictly after this timestamp, using text comparison; other date formats are not normalized or validated.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPCommentList
tools.summary: Read Blueprint comment rectangles, membership and nesting
tools.description: Read Blueprint comment rectangles, membership and nesting. Membership uses node origins inside box rectangles, not full rendered bounds or a stored ownership relation; overlapping membership is reported. Loads the Blueprint; no explicit compile or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty or non-Blueprint targets are refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Existing graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Empty lists all collected graphs; unknown names are refused with available names.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: Optional empty for all boxes, node:<reader ID or unique hex key> for boxes containing that node's origin, box:<comment ID> for intersecting boxes, or region:x,y,width,height in graph units. Region dimensions must be finite and positive; edge-only contact is excluded. Nonempty scope requires GraphName. Relationships are still computed against all boxes.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Optional zero-based matched-box offset, default 0. Use nextOffset from the response; -1 means complete. Pages are live, so restart after graph edits.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Optional maximum whole box records per page, 1..80, default 80. The text budget can shorten a page; omitted counts remain explicit.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPCommonButtonStyle
tools.summary: Inspect or change explicit shared CommonButtonStyle Blueprint defaults
tools.description: Inspect or change explicit shared CommonButtonStyle Blueprint defaults.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required compiled CommonButtonStyle Blueprint path, not a widget. All buttons using this shared asset may change. No compile/save/runtime refresh is performed; recreate affected widgets after compiling to verify visuals.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact reflected path. Empty lists readable fields for read only. Examples: ButtonPadding or NormalHovered.TintColor.SpecifiedColor. Paths descend structs, never objects/containers. Edit conditions and color-use rules still apply. Native references and localized text are read-only.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPDataAssetProperty
tools.summary: Read reflected properties of data assets or already-loaded Blueprint class defaults
tools.description: Read reflected properties of data assets or already-loaded Blueprint class defaults. The first line of a paged read is a JSON object with rows, totals, errors and continuation. The complete flag is true when the first page covers the whole request without errors. Data asset loads may run load hooks and load dependencies. Blueprint defaults use an existing generated class and default object. No property write, save or compile is requested.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Data asset path or unique name. In paged modes, pass up to 64 separated by commas or pipes. Blueprint defaults require full Blueprint package, object or generated class paths.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact reflected path such as Settings.Number. In paged modes, pass up to eight names separated by commas or pipes. Paths can traverse structs and owned instanced children. Empty lists editable fields in legacy mode.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: legacy preserves the single data asset read and edit revision. values pages named values and entries in a selected collection. keys pages map keys or zero-based array indices without reading their values. Default legacy.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: asset reads data assets. blueprint_defaults reads defaults from the existing loaded generated class in a paged mode. It never loads or constructs the class or default object. Defaults can reflect the last compile.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Start at 0. In paged modes copy nextOffset until it is -1. Keep all other inputs and the live data unchanged between pages.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Maximum returned rows in paged modes, 1 to 100. Default 32. A response budget can reduce this count.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPDataTable
tools.summary: Read DataTable schema, row names, selected values and registry-based readers
tools.description: Read DataTable schema, row names, selected values and registry-based readers. Displays up to 80 fields and pages of up to 60 sorted rows with revision-checked continuation. Oversized values are explicitly omitted; request fewer columns to inspect them. Loaded Blueprint input literals are inspected, including unsaved graphs. GetDataTableRow sites are distinguished from generic literal references; registry dependencies alone do not prove a read. Dynamic references and shared row-struct parameter flow are not resolved. Loads the table; no explicit edit or save.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required DataTable path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/DT_Items. Empty or non-DataTable targets are refused.

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: Case-insensitive all, readers, or schema. Empty defaults to all. schema includes row names and selected values; readers omits rows. Unknown filters are refused.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Empty or * selects all values; none selects row names only. Otherwise comma-separated reflected, authored or unique display names. Exact reflected names take precedence; ambiguous/unknown names are refused. Values require Include=all or schema.

parameters.name: TextMode
parameters.description: lossless (default) retains localized text identity; display emits the current localized string for inspection only, not write-back.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset in sorted, filtered rows. Continuations require Revision.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows per page, 1..60. Character limits can shorten a page; use next_offset (-1 means finished).

parameters.name: RowFilter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive row-name substring; empty matches all rows.

parameters.name: Revision
parameters.description: Token from the first page. A changed table or query is refused; restart at Offset=0.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPDirtyList
tools.summary: List loaded content packages marked dirty; does not include unsaved maps or other editor state
tools.description: List loaded content packages marked dirty; does not include unsaved maps or other editor state. Reports package paths and registry classes without loading assets. A clean dirty flag is not proof that memory matches disk. The result reports omitted packages when the requested limit is reached; empty Limit defaults to 50.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Positive decimal maximum number of listed packages, e.g. 100. Empty uses 50; zero, non-digits and values above 2147483647 are refused.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPEditQueue
tools.summary: Inspect editor readiness for ordinary transactional asset edits; does not edit, compile or save
tools.description: Inspect editor readiness for ordinary transactional asset edits; does not edit, compile or save. Reports play/simulation, active transactions, transaction availability and recovery blocks. This is a snapshot, not a queue, permission grant or reservation. Each edit still checks its preferences, asset and safety requirements. Play-control tools have separate rules.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPEditorLog
tools.summary: Read bounded editor/PIE output captured during this enabled plugin session, not tool-call history or a disk file
tools.description: Read bounded editor/PIE output captured during this enabled plugin session, not tool-call history or a disk file. Returns UTC timestamps, categories, severity, cursor and explicit retention/message truncation. Does not run commands or change assets.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: Empty for all categories, otherwise exact case-insensitive category name, such as LogBlueprintUserMessages.

parameters.name: Contains
parameters.description: Empty for all messages, otherwise a case-insensitive substring of stored text (at most 2048 characters).

parameters.name: Since
parameters.description: Empty for all retained times, otherwise inclusive ISO-8601 UTC time ending in Z, such as 2026-10-27T10:00:00Z.

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: Empty starts at oldest retained record. Otherwise copy nextCursor from the previous response and keep filters unchanged. Another-session or future cursor refuses; expired retained records report loss.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum returned records, 1..100, default 50. Whole records also have a 24000-character response budget. Messages are stored up to 2048 UTF-16 characters; truncated tails are not searchable.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPGraphLoad
tools.summary: Read one graph as text
tools.description: Read one graph as text. Pass the asset, the graph name, a format and a detail level. Format `read` is the default and the only one implemented; the engine's own write dialect is refused by name rather than silently returning the wrong thing. Detail levels, each a superset of the one below: `manifest` (entry points by name and counts), `signatures` (entry points with their output pins), `bodies` (the default, every entry point with its body as graph text), and `full` (bodies plus node classes and pin indexes). The graph text is S-expressions, one top level form per event or function, with exec chains reading top to bottom. Every node carries its node ID in a comment, shared value nodes are defined once and referred to by node ID, and reroute references retain their identity while the reader follows the wire. Nodes not reachable from any entry point are listed separately with a count. An event-backed function shows its authored event body and identifies its graph and node. A missing name lists the existing graphs. Read-only node descriptions and display labels supplement the exact node and pin identities in the body. Omit EntryFilter or supply * or an empty string for all entries. A non-empty EntryFilter matches event/function names by case-insensitive substring. Empty reads all entries. Filtered views are inspection-only. Large reads return inspection pages. Use nextOffset and Revision for subsequent pages; keep all other arguments identical. A changed read refuses the stale token. Partial pages are not standalone write-back input.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Existing Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty is refused.

parameters.name: GraphName
parameters.description: Exact graph name, e.g. EventGraph. Inspection may also accept an authored event function name such as ReceiveBeginPlay. Empty is refused.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: read (default, including empty), json, or edit. Read and JSON are inspection formats; JSON returns body, body_notes, revision, offset/count/total and nextOffset (-1 at end) in a standalone object per page and may identify an authored event body. MaxChars counts UTF-16 body units before JSON escaping. Edit exports a versioned document for the exact authored graph only: use Offset=0, first Revision and no EntryFilter. Unsupported, filtered or oversized edit exports are incomplete and cannot be replaced. The write format is unsupported.

parameters.name: Detail
parameters.description: manifest, signatures, bodies or full; default or empty means bodies. Each level adds inspection detail. Edit always exports the whole supported graph.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Zero-based character offset. Start at 0; for later pages use the returned nextOffset and Revision together. Negative values are refused.

parameters.name: MaxChars
parameters.description: Maximum page characters, 256..24000 inclusive; default 24000. Partial pages are inspection-only, not standalone write-back input.

parameters.name: Revision
parameters.description: Omit or supply first or an empty string for page zero. Later pages require the revision token from page zero with unchanged arguments; stale tokens are refused.

parameters.name: EntryFilter
parameters.description: Case-insensitive entry-name substring, e.g. BeginPlay. Empty includes all entries. Filtered views are inspection-only.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPMaterialBlocks

parameters.name: Asset

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPMaterialLabels

parameters.description: Required Material or Material Function path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/M_TurboMCPFixture. Empty/unresolved assets are refused. Instances have no expression graph; read their parent or use ReadTurboMCPMaterialInstance.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPNodeContext
tools.summary: Inspect static execution context and input sources; may load assets, without requesting edits, compile or save
tools.description: Inspect static execution context and input sources; may load assets, without requesting edits, compile or save. parameters.name: Asset

tools.description: Search Blueprint nodes by text; may load assets, without requesting edits, compile or save. tools.name: ReadTurboMCPNodeResolve

tools.description: Resolve node identities and inspect pins; may load assets, without requesting edits, compile or save. Reports engine references, titles, type identities and up to 40 pins per node. tools.description: Read available and implemented Blueprint overrides from parent classes and interfaces. Loads the Blueprint; no explicit compile or save. Counts precede filtering.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPPlayCheck

tools.description: Start or poll a timed Play In Editor session that executes project code with editor permissions, is not sandboxed or automatically undone, and does not explicitly save assets. tools.description: Inspect one exact Blueprint-callable function on an existing PIE runtime object without invoking it.

parameters.description: Maximum tree depth, 1..128. Children beyond it set traversalTruncated. At most 20000 widgets are visited.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPStatus
tools.summary: Read the MCP server state and this plugin's registration state
tools.description: Read the MCP server state and this plugin's registration state. Use this first in a session to find out whether the server is running, on which address, and whether this plugin registered its toolsets. It does not edit assets, start the server or change preferences. Returns one line for the server and one line per TurboMCP toolset, or a line saying why a toolset is missing.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPToolHelp
tools.summary: Read the parameters and known traps of one tool
tools.description: Read the parameters and known traps of one tool. Pass a toolset name and a tool name, or one joined name as tools/list prints it. Leave the tool name empty for the first page of the named toolset. Name the tool alone to find its registered toolset. Works for the engine's own tools as well as TurboMCP's, because engine tool help runs to tens of thousands of characters and the traps are where agents actually lose time. Compact help targets 2000 characters for one tool and keeps the required arguments visible. An unknown name points to discovery. Both fields are optional. Omit both to list available toolsets; omit ToolName to list the named toolset. Other tools retain their own required arguments.

parameters.name: ToolsetName
parameters.description: Optional; * or empty searches all toolsets. With both arguments omitted, lists toolsets. Registered toolset name, e.g. TurboMCP.TurboMCPReadToolset. Empty searches all toolsets for ToolName. Supply an empty string when unused.

parameters.name: ToolName
parameters.description: Optional; * or empty lists tools in the named toolset. ToolSchema uses argument names Toolset and Tool instead. Bare tool name, e.g. ReadTurboMCPStatus. Empty lists the named toolset; use the returned list:<offset> for another page. find:0:<words> searches names and descriptions.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPToolIndex
tools.summary: Read a compact summary of the registered toolsets and their available tool counts
tools.description: Read a compact summary of the registered toolsets and their available tool counts. Includes the server and tool search state. Use ReadTurboMCPToolHelp with an exact ToolsetName and empty ToolName to list one toolset. Continue with list:<offset>, or search with find:0:<words>. Pass a bare tool name for its parameters and known traps. Use describe_toolset for the full schema. The summary reports any toolsets omitted to fit the character limit.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPToolSchema
tools.summary: Inspect registered tool metadata and local trap notes without invoking the described tool
tools.description: Inspect registered tool metadata and local trap notes without invoking the described tool. This is a compact rendering, not the complete JSON schema. Single-tool output is capped at 2000 characters; use describe_toolset for the complete schema. Missing trap notes are reported, not treated as proof that a tool has no limitations.

parameters.name: Toolset
parameters.description: Required string. Empty lists registered toolsets. Prefer the full registry name, e.g. TurboMCP.TurboMCPReadToolset. Short names and suffixes are matched after normalization; the first matching toolset is selected, so use full names to avoid ambiguity.

parameters.name: Tool
parameters.description: Required string. Empty lists tools in the selected toolset. Otherwise use a bare or fully qualified registered tool name, e.g. ReadTurboMCPNodeFind. Matching ignores case, spaces and underscores. Unknown names return suggestions; Toolset must be supplied to select a tool.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPTrace
tools.summary: Report the trace subscription, armed points and retained hits
tools.description: Report the trace subscription, armed points and retained hits. Does not arm or clear points, edit graphs, compile or save assets. Zero hits alone do not prove a node never ran.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Required string. status (case-insensitive) reports the registry; empty also selects status. arm and clear are refused with EditTurboMCPTrace guidance. Other actions are refused. Example: status.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: Required string. Ignored for status; use an empty string. This reader reports the full registry rather than filtering by node ID.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPTypeFind
tools.summary: Find reflected type paths without loading or editing assets; matches do not guarantee pin or writer support
tools.description: Find reflected type paths without loading or editing assets; matches do not guarantee pin or writer support. Searches loaded reflected types and registered user-defined structs/enums. Blueprint generated classes and unloaded native modules are excluded; use AssetSearch/AssetDescribe for Blueprint classes. Every whitespace-separated word must match the name or path. Lists at most 30 matches with omitted counts. Registry scanning reports partial rather than a complete search; unloaded registry paths are not validated.

parameters.name: Words
parameters.description: Required nonempty words, e.g. CoreUObject Vector. All words must match, ignoring case; spaces, tabs and newlines separate words.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Required filter: struct, enum, class, interface or any. Empty means any. Example: struct. Unknown values are refused.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPVcsState
tools.summary: Query the selected source-control provider; may refresh cached state and contact its server, but does not request checkout, save or submission
tools.description: Query the selected source-control provider; may refresh cached state and contact its server, but does not request checkout, save or submission. Reports provider availability and per-asset state. Unavailable or missing provider state is unknown, not evidence that a file is clean or untracked. Results describe the provider response at query time.

parameters.name: Assets
parameters.description: Required comma- or pipe-separated asset paths or unique short names, e.g. /Game/Tests/BP_NodeTest. Empty queries provider status only. Invalid or ambiguous assets are reported individually; other entries are still processed. Use full paths to disambiguate.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPWidgetInventory
tools.summary: Find Widget Blueprints by class, references, overrides and graph nodes
tools.description: Find Widget Blueprints by class, references, overrides and graph nodes. Uses a bounded page of sorted registry candidates and returns JSON evidence. Searches the owned designer tree, including embedded widget instances and local named-slot content, and owned Blueprint graphs. Embedded internals, inherited trees, native implementations, maps, sets and dynamic references are outside scope. Values compare against existing class defaults. Loading an unloaded candidate may run PostLoad or dependency compilation and dirty packages. No explicit compilation, save, checkout, map opening or PIE.

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description: JSON object with at least one exact string rule. class accepts a Widget or RichTextBlockDecorator class path and matches subclasses. asset accepts a full object path. assetFolder matches a content folder recursively. override and call accept function names. nodeClass accepts an EdGraphNode class path and matches subclasses.

parameters.name: Folder
parameters.description: Mounted content folder without trailing slash, e.g. /Game/UI. Default "project" searches /Game and enabled project plugin content recursively.

parameters.name: Recursive
parameters.description: Include candidate subfolders when Folder is explicit. Default true.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description: all requires every rule somewhere in the same Blueprint. any requires at least one rule. Default all.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Maximum Widget Blueprint candidates to inspect per call, 1 to 16. Default 8.

parameters.name: Cursor
parameters.description: Use first initially. Copy nextCursor with the same filters to continue. An empty nextCursor ends the scan. Totals remain unknown until all candidates are inspected.

parameters.name: LoadUnloaded
parameters.description: Allow bounded candidate package loads. Set false for loaded candidates only, with unloaded candidates reported as skipped. Default true.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPWidgetProperty
tools.summary: Read supported widget or parent-slot properties without compiling or saving
tools.description: Read supported widget or parent-slot properties without compiling or saving. Supports editable scalar values, simple value structs, and exact hard object/class references. Dotted paths descend named struct fields only. Containers, delegates, localized text, ownership and instanced references are excluded. Reference values are exact paths or None when unset. This is not a full widget export.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique name; prefer /Game/UI/WBP_Menu.

parameters.name: Widget
parameters.description: Required designer object name from ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree, not display text or a runtime instance path.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Required widget or slot. Slot means the named widget's parent slot; a root without a slot refuses.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Exact name or dotted struct-field path, such as Visibility, Brush.ResourceObject or EntryWidgetClass. Empty lists up to 160 supported paths, types and values. Navigation is read-only on Target=widget and reports stored Designer rules; it does not observe runtime focus.

tools.name: ReadTurboMCPWidgetTree
tools.summary: Inspect selected Widget Blueprint hierarchy data; loads the asset without explicitly editing, compiling or saving it
tools.description: Inspect selected Widget Blueprint hierarchy data; loads the asset without explicitly editing, compiling or saving it. This is not a complete or lossless export. Reports names, classes, paths, variable flags, non-default visibility and selected padding. Panel children retain slot order; this alone does not establish visual draw order. Common Button context adds the assigned style class and inherited hover-event names as inspection comments; style values and runtime overrides remain omitted. Other properties, bindings and animations are omitted. Do not assume write-back preserves omitted state.

parameters.name: Asset
parameters.description: Required Widget Blueprint path or unique short name, e.g. /Game/Tests/WBP_NodeTest. Empty, unresolved or non-widget assets are refused. A widget without a root returns an explicit no-root result.
